umc.cmc.4p7gv4trt1rt0kuiwzmitibiv.original: A determined father (Matthew McConaughey) risks everything to rescue a dedicated teacher (America Ferrera) and her students from a raging wildfire. Inspired by a true story of survival.

umc.cmc.3hac5oqhh3gxiu35spyu8fanf.text: Laura 和 Simon 自大学以来一直是最好的朋友。多年来，他们意识到彼此的纽带已经超越了柏拉图式的友情。他们能否——又是否应该——冒着失去一切的风险去探索这份一直存在的爱？
umc.cmc.3hac5oqhh3gxiu35spyu8fanf.original: Laura and Simon have been best friends since college. Over the years, they’ve realized their bond is more than platonic. Can they—and should they—risk everything to explore a love that has existed all along?

umc.cmc.237ur6qdup9h826huv7jg25yu.text: 尤金李维踏出舒适圈，造访世上各种迷人的旅游胜地。
umc.cmc.237ur6qdup9h826huv7jg25yu.original: Award-winning actor and nervous explorer Eugene Levy steps out of his comfort zone for a whirlwind tour of the world’s most beautiful and intriguing destinations.

umc.cmc.25tn3v8ku4b39tr6ccgb8nl6m.text: 让我们揭开帷幕，聚焦每晨陪伴大众迎接新一天的新闻主播，走近早间新闻节目的台前幕后！ 剧集由詹妮弗·安妮斯顿、瑞茜·威瑟斯彭和史蒂夫·卡瑞尔领衔主演，以大胆直接的拍摄手法透视当代职场百态。
umc.cmc.25tn3v8ku4b39tr6ccgb8nl6m.original: Pull back the curtain on early morning TV. Starring Reese Witherspoon and Jennifer Aniston, this unapologetically candid drama looks at the modern workplace through the lens of the people who help America wake up.

umc.cmc.3rbg43tt2brl2cp5wwacfrmhx.text: 当有权有势的音乐大亨（丹泽尔·华盛顿 饰）成为被勒索的对象，他被迫维护自己的家庭与丰功伟业，同时面对攸关生死的道德难题。 影片改编自黑泽明同名经典电影，原著是爱德华·伯恩斯的小说《King's Ransom》。
umc.cmc.3rbg43tt2brl2cp5wwacfrmhx.original: When a powerful music mogul (Denzel Washington) is targeted by a ransom plot, he is forced to fight for his family and legacy while jammed up in a life-or-death moral dilemma.

umc.cmc.40xdlw2jijoj95c3a6y2m3738.original: On a charming island, Square, Triangle, and Circle seek adventure and connection while learning how to navigate each other’s differences. Based on the internationally best-selling books by Mac Barnett and Jon Klassen.

umc.cmc.1yvpbd5uvcq8txtj1gfnw5iox.text: 全球音乐偶像与世界知名的 K-pop 偶像联手进行精彩的歌曲对决。这些艺术家以 K-pop 的风格演绎他们最大的热门歌曲，在争夺终极炫耀权的友谊赛中惊艳全场、大显身手并震撼全场。
umc.cmc.1yvpbd5uvcq8txtj1gfnw5iox.original: Global music icons team up with world-renowned K-pop idols for spectacular song battles. Performing their biggest hits with a K-pop twist, these artists show up, show out, and shut it down in a friendly competition for the ultimate bragging rights.

umc.cmc.70b7z97fv7azfzn5baqnj88p6.text: Simon Kinberg与David Weil负责的Apple TV+的外星人题材剧将讲述全球多地被外星人入侵时的情况，会有纽约﹑曼彻斯特﹑摩洛哥及日本四国的剧情。
umc.cmc.70b7z97fv7azfzn5baqnj88p6.original: Earth is visited by an alien species that threatens humanity’s existence. Events unfold in real time through the eyes of five ordinary people across the globe as they struggle to make sense of the chaos unraveling around them.

umc.cmc.y7bc18x7co813l8i2tlsyb4l.text: 本剧由夫妻档Nick Stoller和Francesca Delbanco撰写剧本，计划制作成诗选剧，每季聚焦不同的两个人物。故事将探讨柏拉图式友情的内在运作方式。一对年轻时认识的前好友，成年后重新开始联络，试图冰释前嫌。随着两人的友谊变得越来越令人身心俱疲，这段关系动摇了他们的生活，促使他们重新评估自己的选择。
umc.cmc.y7bc18x7co813l8i2tlsyb4l.original: In this series from the director of Neighbors, a platonic pair of former best friends approaching midlife (Seth Rogen and Rose Byrne) reconnect after a long rift. The duo’s friendship becomes more consuming—and destabilizes their lives in a hilarious way.

umc.cmc.6ag0zq020ielwv7m83v8r4dkw.text: 从土著人的角度讲述了夏威夷群岛的统一，这是一个激动人心的、前所未有的故事。一位夏威夷战争首领加入了一场血腥的战役，以团结交战岛屿，使其免受殖民威胁。
umc.cmc.6ag0zq020ielwv7m83v8r4dkw.original: Embark on an epic adventure about the origin of Hawai‘i and its people. Jason Momoa stars as Kaʻiana, a fearless warrior on a mission to unite his homeland as a monumental power struggle erupts among the four kingdoms.

umc.cmc.8xrkg9zywke7g6a9ahmvpr3l.text: Apple TV+预定半小时双语喜剧《阿卡普尔科 Acapulco》。 这是一部西班牙语-英语剧集，Eugenio Derbez担任执行制片并出演，灵感来自他主演的电影《如何做一名拉丁情人 How to Be A Latin Lover》。 故事讲述一名年轻墨西哥男子梦想成真，在阿卡普尔科最热门的度假胜地找到了一份千载难逢的工作。随着自己所有的信仰和道德观念都开始被颠覆，他很快意识到这份工作比想象中要复杂得多。该剧背景为1984年，Derbez饰演当下时刻的主角，并担任旁白。 本剧由《佐伊的超凡歌单》主创Austin Winsberg，和《半血缘兄弟》编剧Eduardo Cisneros、Jason Shuman共同创作。Winsberg担任剧集运作人，《老爸老妈浪漫史》编剧Chris Harris为联合剧集运作人。
umc.cmc.8xrkg9zywke7g6a9ahmvpr3l.original: In 1984, Maximo Gallardo’s dream comes true when he gets the job of a lifetime at Acapulco’s hottest resort, Las Colinas. But he soon realizes that working there will be far more complicated than he ever imagined.

umc.cmc.5983fipzqbicvrve6jdfep4x3.text: 故事设定在第二季事件的152年后。
umc.cmc.5983fipzqbicvrve6jdfep4x3.original: Based on the award-winning novels by Isaac Asimov, Foundation chronicles a band of exiles on their monumental journey to save humanity and rebuild civilization amid the fall of the Galactic Empire.

umc.cmc.4w1tfn11hyb3frc9tp5fpksbb.text: 与三位专家一起探索地球的隐秘角落，他们正试图拯救六种濒临灭绝的物种。凭借精湛的摄影技术和生存技能，团队争分夺秒地寻找、记录并保护这些神出鬼没的生物，以免为时已晚。
umc.cmc.4w1tfn11hyb3frc9tp5fpksbb.original: Explore hidden corners of Earth with a trio of experts as they try to save six endangered species from extinction. With crafty camerawork and survival skills, the team race to find, record, and protect these elusive creatures before it’s too late.

umc.cmc.4lplbt076d3um4tenis7k58e3.text: 麻烦缠身的警察和神秘的火灾调查员联手追踪两名连环纵火犯。
umc.cmc.4lplbt076d3um4tenis7k58e3.original: When an arson investigator begrudgingly teams up with a police detective, their race to stop two arsonists ignites a twisted game of secrets and suspicions.

umc.cmc.g28hcpusm23xbs9zwvnwn9re.text: 本剧灵感来自普利策奖获奖作家伊迪丝·华顿未完成的同名最终作，由全女性创意团队主导。英国喜剧演员Katherine Jakeways为剧集创作者和领头编剧，Susanna White（《安多》《荒凉山庄》《简爱（2006）》）担任领头导演，两人同Beth Willis（《援助》《神秘博士》）均为执行制片。The Forge Entertainment为制片方，所以这应该是一部英剧。 有钱的女孩，有权力的男人。新财富，旧秘密。1870年代（19世纪70年代），一群喜爱玩乐的年轻美国女孩闯入满是紧身胸衣的伦敦社交季，掀起了一场英美文化冲突。她们对数百年传统的漠视令人耳目一新，悄然渗透着英国这片感情克制（上嘴唇僵硬/stiff upper lip）的土地。“海盗”们被家族派去寻找丈夫、获取贵族头衔，但她们的心之所向远不止于此，一句“我愿意”只是个开始。
umc.cmc.g28hcpusm23xbs9zwvnwn9re.original: A group of fun-loving American girls burst onto the scene in tightly corseted 1870s London, kicking off an Anglo-American culture clash. Sent to secure husbands and status, the buccaneers’ hearts are set on much more than that.

umc.cmc.1al6pi2y17htw3z98tbacgo55.text: 讲述女子凯特·加勒特因个人悲剧而摇摇欲坠，她在与世隔绝、风景如画的回声谷农场寄宿并训练马匹。一天深夜，她任性不羁的女儿克莱尔出现在家门口，惊恐颤抖、身上沾满了别人的血。一个母亲为了救她的孩子要付出多少？
umc.cmc.1al6pi2y17htw3z98tbacgo55.original: Julianne Moore is Kate, whose secluded life is interrupted by her troubled daughter (Sydney Sweeney) when she shows up frightened and covered in someone's blood. As Kate unravels the shocking truth, she learns how far she’ll go for her child.

umc.cmc.5v5f721a2mlxcurdhh0wm56if.text: 和机灵的兔子莱利一起发挥创意！只需一个纸箱，莱利就能想象出充满新朋友和奇妙冒险的魔法世界。改编自安托瓦内特·波蒂斯屡获殊荣的畅销书系列。
umc.cmc.5v5f721a2mlxcurdhh0wm56if.original: Get creative with bright-eyed bunny Riley! With just one cardboard box, Riley imagines magical worlds full of new friends and fantastic adventures. Based on the award-winning book series by Antoinette Portis.

umc.cmc.oxoxnpaecaatg9tzf6pgfsh2.text: 通过言语、音乐和恶作剧，博诺揭开了塑造他成为儿子、父亲、丈夫、活动家和U2乐队主唱的那些极其个人化经历的面纱。
umc.cmc.oxoxnpaecaatg9tzf6pgfsh2.original: Through words, music, and mischief, Bono pulls back the curtain on his deeply personal experiences that have shaped him as a son, father, husband, activist, and U2 frontman.

umc.cmc.3q3rnlgmnlkdh3p5djze6l019.text: 为了传播善良，热爱快乐的露露踏上了毕生难忘的冒险之旅，背后支撑她的是新朋友、勇气和动听的歌曲！
umc.cmc.3q3rnlgmnlkdh3p5djze6l019.original: On a quest to spread kindness, fun-loving Lulu embarks on the adventure of a lifetime, powered by new friends, courage, and catchy songs!

umc.cmc.z5xrwbjg3gergiowhrzg61tq.text: 一对关系疏远的兄妹联手展开了一场跨国劫盗行动，目标是找出传说中的“不老泉”，而这一路上，兄妹俩利用自己的历史知识破解沿途的各种线索，这段史诗般的冒险将改变他们的生活——并可能达到永生。
umc.cmc.z5xrwbjg3gergiowhrzg61tq.original: A treasure-hunting mastermind (John Krasinski) assembles a team for a life-changing adventure. But to outwit and outrun threats at every turn, he’ll need someone even smarter than he is: his estranged sister (Natalie Portman).

umc.cmc.4db5r1gvgok0a0dtdmkj44ea4.text: 本片揭示一场鲜为人知、最伟大的民权运动故事。1988年，在世界上唯一的聋人大学里，四名学生必须在动荡的八天里找到办法领导一场革命并改变历史进程。
umc.cmc.4db5r1gvgok0a0dtdmkj44ea4.original: Discover the story of the greatest civil rights movement most people have never heard about. During eight tumultuous days in 1988 at the world’s only Deaf university, four students must find a way to lead a revolution—and change the course of history.

umc.cmc.5owrzntj9v1gpg31wshflud03.text: 根据玛莎·威尔斯（Martha Wells）畅销的雨果奖和星云奖获奖系列书籍改编，《谋杀机器人》（Murderbot）是一部科幻惊悚/喜剧作品，讲述了一个自我黑客化的安全构造体的故事。它对人类情感感到恐惧，却又被自己脆弱的客户所吸引。在完成一项危险任务的同时，谋杀机器人必须隐藏自己的自由意志，而它真正想做的只是独自一人观看未来主义肥皂剧，并思考自己在宇宙中的位置。
umc.cmc.5owrzntj9v1gpg31wshflud03.original: In a high-tech future, a rogue security robot (Alexander Skarsgård) secretly gains free will. To stay hidden, it reluctantly joins a new mission protecting scientists on a dangerous planet…even though it just wants to binge soap operas.

umc.cmc.26p8x4co2wl0ztetek4gmkf6r.text: 挚友伊万·麦格雷戈和查理·布鲁曼为第四季的长途跋涉系列做好了准备——这一次他们将从伊万在苏格兰的家出发，前往查理在英格兰的家。当然，他们会选择风景优美的路线，骑着毛病百出的老旧摩托车穿越17个欧洲国家。
umc.cmc.26p8x4co2wl0ztetek4gmkf6r.original: Best friends Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman gear up for their fourth Long Way series—this time going from Ewan’s home in Scotland to Charley’s in England. They’ll take the scenic route, of course, through 17 European countries on cranky old bikes.

umc.cmc.4280po7j44ucyyg09iugnldvo.text: 聚焦“法国第一个名厨”Antonin Carême，他在拿破仑时期白手起家，成为蜚声全欧洲的厨师，同时也成为一名间谍，涉及19世纪厨师界和贵族名流圈的故事。
umc.cmc.4280po7j44ucyyg09iugnldvo.original: Witness the rise of the world’s first celebrity chef, Antonin Carême, and his descent into espionage in Napoleon-era France—where manipulation is king. With his gifts for gastronomy and seduction, he becomes the perfect weapon in a fight for power.

umc.cmc.2fjnrld5buccid3lqqex95lnw.text: 9岁的珍珍是一个崭露头角的环保主义者。她致力于拯救濒危动物。珍珍运用自己丰富的想象力，带领最好的朋友大卫和黑猩猩灰胡踏上了史诗般的冒险之旅，去保护世界各地的野生动物。
umc.cmc.2fjnrld5buccid3lqqex95lnw.original: Budding environmentalist Jane is a 9-year-old on a quest to save endangered animals. Using her powerful imagination, Jane takes her best friends David and Greybeard the chimpanzee on epic adventures to help protect wild animals all around the world.

umc.cmc.1pgdmfreds5kuzmeo3xii0746.text: 故事发生在 1969 年的圣费尔南多谷，讲述了钱伯斯一家追求崇高而看似不可能实现的梦想的故事。汉普顿·钱伯斯（奥伊罗沃饰）出狱后，期待已久的家庭团聚并没有按照他的计划进行。在他出狱期间，汉普顿的妻子阿斯托利亚（米西克 饰）和儿子爱因斯坦（埃里森 饰）、哈里森（迪阿洛·温斯顿 饰）组成了一个非传统的家庭单元，汉普顿的回归让他们的世界陷入混乱。
umc.cmc.1pgdmfreds5kuzmeo3xii0746.original: When Hampton (David Oyelowo) is released from prison, his long-awaited family reunion doesn’t quite go as he hoped. In his absence, Hampton’s wife and sons formed an unconventional family unit, and his return spins their world into chaos.

umc.cmc.6p9tke2tbri1vnn2cuaxcj4mi.text: 好莱坞的一些超级巨星倾情揭秘他们走向颠覆性主角的历程。在坦诚的采访中，他们阐述了演艺生涯的高潮与低谷、突破时刻、成功蓝图以及下一代巨大的潜力。
umc.cmc.6p9tke2tbri1vnn2cuaxcj4mi.original: Some of Hollywood’s biggest stars reveal their journeys to game-changing leading roles. In candid interviews, they shine a light on the highs and lows of their craft, breakthrough moments, blueprints for success, and the next generation’s huge potential.

umc.cmc.6x620ggn8n2yamemiuk7ys8yt.text: 以前所未有的视角体验洋基队和道奇队重现 2024 年美国职业棒球大联盟（MLB）最具代表性的季后赛两强对决，并近距离深入访谈超级球星、主教练及其家人，见证登上棒球界最高宝座所需的牺牲。
umc.cmc.6x620ggn8n2yamemiuk7ys8yt.original: Experience the battle of juggernauts like never before as the Yankees and Dodgers revive MLB’s most iconic playoff rivalry. With intimate access to superstar players, managers, and their families, witness the sacrifices it takes to claim baseball’s throne.

umc.cmc.1pwtcaq7wyb6hdz2ctk1tvtng.text: 受到电子游戏《Mythic Quest》（2020）影响的员工、玩家和粉丝的生活。
umc.cmc.1pwtcaq7wyb6hdz2ctk1tvtng.original: Go deeper into the Mythic Quest universe in these four standalone stories. Follow the lives of players, comic book shop owners, touring orchestra musicians, and members of the art department as they search for community, success, and love.

umc.cmc.7518algxc4lsoobtsx30dqb52.text: 讲述了一位新上任的电影制片公司负责人为了赢得名人的认可，他和大陆影业的执行团队必须在公司利益和创意追求之间寻求平衡。同时还要力图为电影制作注入新的生机和活力，并与时俱进。
umc.cmc.7518algxc4lsoobtsx30dqb52.original: Seth Rogen stars as the newly appointed head of a movie studio. Desperate for celebrity approval, he and his executive team at Continental Studios must juggle corporate demands with creative ambitions as they try to keep movies alive and relevant.

umc.cmc.18fsq2h43zx0v5h31hyeq1d7w.text: 在一个每个人的角色都已注定的城镇里，一位有抱负的创作歌手和她的乐队成员挣脱束缚，去追求梦想，并激励其他人也这样做。
umc.cmc.18fsq2h43zx0v5h31hyeq1d7w.original: In a town where everyone’s roles are predetermined, an aspiring singer-songwriter and her bandmates break free to pursue their dreams and inspire others to do the same.

umc.cmc.2prcvu6fnh4bue7d9iaswpsw7.text: 故事讲述的是多年好友和不良少年假扮缉毒局探员抢劫一栋乡间别墅，却无意中揭露并揭开了东部沿海最大的毒品隐秘通道。
umc.cmc.2prcvu6fnh4bue7d9iaswpsw7.original: Two lifelong friends (Brian Tyree Henry and Wagner Moura) in Philadelphia pose as DEA agents to rob small-time drug dealers. It’s a perfect grift—until they choose the wrong mark and become targets of a massive narcotics enterprise.

umc.cmc.24ebs6sf9yyg4e5tpdwoywkzt.text: 一位年轻女医生的私生活陷入困境后，为寻求新的开始，接手柏林最艰难、最混乱医院的急诊室。面对员工的抵触和破旧系统的同时，她必须团结这支特立独行的团队来挽救生命。
umc.cmc.24ebs6sf9yyg4e5tpdwoywkzt.original: After her private life falls apart, a young doctor seeking a fresh start takes over the emergency room in Berlin’s toughest, most chaotic hospital. Battling staff resistance and a run-down system, she must unite her maverick team to save lives.

umc.cmc.dzqzvmbvizbedk91cvrq5pvw.text: 头部受伤让苏菲严重失忆。苏菲在丈夫与朋友的协助下重新拼凑人生片段，同时开始质疑她看似完美生活背后的真相。
umc.cmc.dzqzvmbvizbedk91cvrq5pvw.original: A traumatic head injury leaves Sophie with extreme memory loss. In her quest to put the pieces of her life back together—with help from her husband and friends—Sophie begins to question the truth behind her picture-perfect life.

umc.cmc.3f1lyzz5mshnl8umwl9wipwgj.text: 不仅关心球场上的表现，更以前所未有的角度，了解推动美国职业足球大联盟的球员和人物。振奋人心的时刻和引人入胜的故事让2024年成为令人难忘的赛季，我们也借此一窥未来的发展。
umc.cmc.3f1lyzz5mshnl8umwl9wipwgj.original: Go beyond the pitch with unparalleled access to the players and personalities who power MLS. Electrifying moments and captivating stories made 2024 an unforgettable season—and gave us a glimpse of the future.

umc.cmc.26o403koqo2klixc0jtqy6tmc.text: 两名训练有素的特工被派往神秘峡谷的对立两侧执行保护任务，并因此变得亲密。当邪恶势力出现时，他们必须携手合作，以求在峡谷中的未知险境中生存下来。
umc.cmc.26o403koqo2klixc0jtqy6tmc.original: Two highly trained operatives (Miles Teller and Anya Taylor-Joy) grow close from a distance after being sent to guard opposite sides of a mysterious gorge. When an evil below emerges, they must work together to survive what lies within.

umc.cmc.2reh3g5q197hlblohp6l3fzk5.text: 这部剧集时长半小时，共 13 集，讲述了心胸宽广的巨人女孩戈尔迪和她的好朋友在他们心爱的小镇博伊森堡踏上史诗般的冒险之旅。他们一起了解到与众不同是一件值得庆祝的事情，这个世界上每个人都有自己的空间，即使是巨人。
umc.cmc.2reh3g5q197hlblohp6l3fzk5.original: Follow Goldie as she shakes up her beloved town of Boysenberg with her best friends. Together, they learn that being different is something to celebrate—and it’s a whole lot of fun.

umc.cmc.5louo8zb5eb7zs0dgk06tnk22.text: 老友重聚、第一人称叙述以及罕见的镜头，描绘了一幅非凡而深邃的画面，展现了经历历史最长战争之一的生活是什么样的。伊桑·霍克担任旁白。
umc.cmc.5louo8zb5eb7zs0dgk06tnk22.original: The reunion of old friends, first-person accounts, and rarely seen footage paint an extraordinary and deeply profound picture of what it was like to live through one of history’s longest wars. Narrated by Ethan Hawke.

umc.cmc.1nfdfd5zlk05fo1bwwetzldy3.text: 《神话任务》由Rob McElhenney和Charlie Day执行制作，与Ubisoft共同制作，包括Ubisoft的电视与电影负责人Jason Altman、电视与电影总监Danielle Kreinik，与行销发行副总裁Gérard Guillemot都参与其中，并于去年Ubisoft E3展前记者会首度公开此项合作计划。 这部剧集将以McElhenney饰演的游戏研发工作室创意总监Ian Grimm为中心人物，带来九集幽默的影集内容，看看研发团队在负责一款广受欢迎的多人线上游戏时所面临的众多挑战，在这个忙着打造游戏世界、塑造英雄角色与创造史诗故事的工作场域中，最大的战争并没有发生在游戏，而是出现在办公室中。
umc.cmc.1nfdfd5zlk05fo1bwwetzldy3.original: Meet the team behind the biggest multiplayer video game of all time. But in a workplace focused on building worlds, molding heroes, and creating legends, the most hard-fought battles don’t occur in the game—they happen in the office.

umc.cmc.49ts9z2smhboe9tweoygj8gv2.text: 加入充满羽毛的趣味冒险，伊娃在树顶社区中寻找历险。每天晚上，她汲取教训、通过写作进行反思，并在力所能及的地方伸出援助之翼。改编自畅销书系 Owl Diaries。
umc.cmc.49ts9z2smhboe9tweoygj8gv2.original: Join in on feathery fun as Eva seeks adventure in her treetop community. Each night, she learns lessons, reflects through writing, and lends a helping wing wherever she can. Based on the best-selling book series Owl Diaries.

umc.cmc.5hje8i3v25dzow2olljxetnus.text: 一名才华横溢的剑桥数学系学生（利奥·伍道尔饰）正处于重大突破的边缘，而一个神秘的敌人试图阻止他。为了寻求答案和拯救生命，他与一名政府特工联手，揭开一场高风险的阴谋。
umc.cmc.5hje8i3v25dzow2olljxetnus.original: A brilliant Cambridge math student (Leo Woodall) is on the verge of a major breakthrough when a shadowy enemy tries to stop him. Fighting for answers—and his life—he teams up with a government agent to unravel a high-stakes conspiracy.

umc.cmc.1srk2goyh2q2zdxcx605w8vtx.text: 故事发生在一家名为卢蒙的超级大公司内，一种名为记忆切割术的全新技术正在公司内部进行实验，接受了手术的员工将进行人格分离手术，形成公司人格和日常人格。这项大胆的“平衡工作与生活”的实验受到了质疑。员工马克发现自己身处一个谜团的中心，迫使他面对工作和自我的本质。 第二季中，马克和他的朋友们了解到切割记忆的可怕后果，使他们走上了更加痛苦的道路。
umc.cmc.1srk2goyh2q2zdxcx605w8vtx.original: Mark leads a team of office workers whose memories have been surgically divided between their work and personal lives. When a mysterious colleague appears outside of work, it begins a journey to discover the truth about their jobs.

umc.cmc.2o8al5w2z01dnm4f9aw11d2w7.text: 探索动物们应对生活中最非凡挑战的聪明且富有创意的方式，从离开家园到寻找伴侣。由休·博内威利担任旁白。
umc.cmc.2o8al5w2z01dnm4f9aw11d2w7.original: Discover the clever and creative ways animals navigate life’s most extraordinary challenges, from leaving home to finding a partner. Narrated by Hugh Bonneville.

umc.cmc.2wyy7chw6bmy46fekqlqq1ulb.text: 踏上一场众星云集、歌声满载的旅程，名人们共乘一辆车，跟随自己的播放列表一起歌唱，并展开各种冒险。
umc.cmc.2wyy7chw6bmy46fekqlqq1ulb.original: Go on a star-studded, song-filled ride as celebrities share a car, sing along to their personal playlists, and embark on adventures.

umc.cmc.4ckulbycyeuavnlen3du06vvy.text: 欢迎来到 Sagoville，哈维在这里喜欢玩耍并寻找带来傻气乐趣的方法！通过充满创意的冒险和令人难忘的歌曲，他和最亲密的朋友们一起探索、想象，并对大大小小的事物表达由衷的谢意。
umc.cmc.4ckulbycyeuavnlen3du06vvy.original: Welcome to Sagoville, where Harvey loves to play and discover ways to have silly fun! He and his closest friends explore, imagine, and express true thankfulness for all things, big and small, through creative adventures and unforgettable songs.

umc.cmc.76dp605jvw9didum9xrra5hvc.text: 在塔利班重新掌权之后，一群喀布尔女性为她们的权利和生命展开了一场革命性的斗争。由制片人马拉拉·尤沙夫赛和詹妮弗·劳伦斯倾力打造。
umc.cmc.76dp605jvw9didum9xrra5hvc.original: In the wake of the Taliban’s return to power, a group of Kabul women lead a revolutionary fight for their rights—and their lives. From producers Malala Yousafzai and Jennifer Lawrence.

umc.cmc.1ivowfwigmx4dmfii3xekmoaq.text: 影片讲述了二战时期伦敦的9岁男孩George（埃利奥特·赫弗南 饰）的史诗之旅，他的母亲Rita（西尔莎·罗南 饰）将他送到了安全的英国乡村。George不屈不挠，决心回到伦敦东部的Rita和外祖父Gerald（保罗·韦勒 饰）身边，于是他开始了一场冒险，却发现自己身处巨大的危险之中，而心烦意乱的Rita则在寻找她失踪的儿子。
umc.cmc.1ivowfwigmx4dmfii3xekmoaq.original: In World War II London, nine-year-old George is evacuated to the countryside by his mother, Rita, to escape the bombings. Defiant and determined to return to his family, George embarks on an epic, perilous journey back home as Rita searches for him.

umc.cmc.14kr4vv65unannh7doqgvlh20.text: 女主遭到富豪丈夫的百般羞辱，她的妹妹们决定让她老公早点归西，事成之后，一对保险公司员工上门，来调查富豪之死的真相。
umc.cmc.14kr4vv65unannh7doqgvlh20.original: The tight-knit Garvey sisters have always looked out for one another. But when the toxic brother-in-law they all wanted dead actually dies, it turns their lives upside down and tests their bond like nothing before.

umc.cmc.4uwoba1ftlsr5da94wc98ilsc.text: 一位最近丧偶的儿童心理学家会见了他的下一位客户，这位客户似乎以某种方式与他的过去有关。
umc.cmc.4uwoba1ftlsr5da94wc98ilsc.original: After tragically losing his wife, child psychiatrist Dr. Eli Adler (Billy Crystal) encounters a troubled young boy who seems to have a haunting connection to Eli’s past.

umc.cmc.1cbgkx1fenkjtrha0n1a6fkc3.text: 本剧改编自蕾妮·奈特的同名小说。 著名记者Catherine Ravenscroft（凯特·布兰切特 Cate Blanchett 饰）因揭露他人的不端行为而声名鹊起。在收到一位不知名作者的小说后，她惊恐地发现自己就是书中的主角，而这个故事揭露了自己最黑暗的秘密。 在Catherine争分夺秒揭开作者真实身份的过程中，她不得不直面过去，以免它毁掉自己的生活，毁掉自己与丈夫Robert（萨莎·拜伦·科恩 Sacha Baron Cohen 饰）、儿子Nicholas（柯蒂·斯密特-麦菲 Kodi Smit-McPhee 饰）的关系。
umc.cmc.1cbgkx1fenkjtrha0n1a6fkc3.original: A mysterious delivery threatens to expose a celebrated journalist’s past. Cate Blanchett and Kevin Kline star in a series written for the screen and directed by Alfonso Cuarón.

umc.cmc.2ifcc56qkxiso1w9k6qwv8aow.text: 在济州岛海岸，一群坚毅的韩国海女们奋力捍卫着她们逐渐消失的文化，以对抗迫近的威胁。
umc.cmc.2ifcc56qkxiso1w9k6qwv8aow.original: On the shores of Jeju Island, a fierce group of South Korean divers fight to save their vanishing culture from looming threats.

umc.cmc.4zami3bauzt4rzxhh4tzfmrfl.text: 潘多拉、拉斯和斯凯·范德胡芬，一个被他们的祖先从世界各地掠夺古代文物所诅咒的家庭，在这个家庭中，父亲亚历克斯被变成了石头。在逆转了一生冒险的诅咒后，第二季中亚历克斯重新加入了这个家庭，他们继续努力消除贪婪的祖先造成的伤害。但是当亚历克斯的某些事情看起来不太对劲时，这个家庭必须团结起来解决他们面临的神秘问题，无论是在路上还是在布莱尔斯通庄园的墙内。
umc.cmc.4zami3bauzt4rzxhh4tzfmrfl.original: The Vanderhouvens are a typical family…except a curse recently turned Alex—their loving husband and father—to stone. In order to save him, his wife and kids set out on spine-tingling adventures to return ancient artifacts stolen by an ancestor.

umc.cmc.1xkd0bjglgv5x1jxiteog2833.text: 玛丽加比白天是一名医学生，而到了晚上，她和家人在墨西哥城竞争激烈的私家救护车行业中拯救生命。面对来自两个世界的压力威胁，玛丽加比将不惜一切代价维持生计。
umc.cmc.1xkd0bjglgv5x1jxiteog2833.original: Marigaby is a medical student by day—and by night, she saves lives with her family in Mexico City’s high-stakes business of private ambulances. As pressure from both worlds threatens to drag her down, Marigaby will do whatever it takes to stay afloat.

umc.cmc.c3xhu25rw4jxxxzq4oio6snu.text: 同为职业“清理工”的两人意外撞单，接到了同一个任务——掩盖一起犯罪现场。迫于局势，互相看不顺眼的两位“孤狼”被迫联手，摆脱一连串的致命麻烦。然而，他们发现整件事正逐渐失控……
umc.cmc.c3xhu25rw4jxxxzq4oio6snu.original: Two rival fixers (George Clooney and Brad Pitt) cross paths when they’re both called in to help cover up a prominent New York official’s misstep. Over one explosive night, they’ll have to set aside their petty grievances—and their egos—to finish the job.

umc.cmc.gs1b84yx68istiomnshllt1i.text: 在这部深入标志性法国高级定制时装屋幕后的作品中，高级时尚与高潮迭起的戏剧性碰撞。当该时装屋背后的家族王朝陷入丑闻时，他们必须找到重塑自我的方法，否则将被竞争对手毁灭。
umc.cmc.gs1b84yx68istiomnshllt1i.original: High fashion meets high drama in this behind-the-curtain look at an iconic French haute couture house. When the family dynasty behind the house falls into scandal, they must find a way to reinvent themselves—or be destroyed by their rivals.

umc.cmc.j0nrrycfzizv3g28dhz2bks.text: 在这部展现来自世界各地艺术家的后台通行证中，浮华与坚韧交织。通过种种考验与胜利，新星们将他们的一切奉献给了一门要求绝对完美的艺术形式。
umc.cmc.j0nrrycfzizv3g28dhz2bks.original: Glitz meets grit in this backstage pass to artists from around the world. Through trials and triumphs, up-and-coming stars give everything they’ve got to an art form that demands nothing less than perfection.

umc.cmc.gtk0q9t2mapcjs75d31vvrs2.text: 通过48分钟的全新片段，全方位领略这部史诗巨作的辉煌。通过拿破仑与妻子约瑟芬多变的复杂关系这一视角，这是一部关于这位法国军事领袖的出身以及迅速、无情地攀升为皇帝的个人审视。
umc.cmc.gtk0q9t2mapcjs75d31vvrs2.original: Witness this epic in its full glory with 48 minutes of new footage. A personal look at the French military leader’s origins and swift, ruthless climb to emperor, it's viewed through the prism of Napoleon’s volatile relationship with his wife, Josephine.

umc.cmc.17vf6g68dy89kk1l1nnb6min4.text: 该剧改编自李敏金的同名畅销小说。讲述了横跨四个世代的韩国移民家庭的故事。故事始于一段禁忌的爱恋，并扩展为跨越韩国、日本与美国三地，关于希望与梦想、和平、爱与失落、胜利与算计的史诗传奇。 从朝鲜到日本，四代移民家庭的恩怨纠葛，大时代的巨光照在每一个小人物的身上，都留下了一道崎 岖的阴影，生生地拖着他们的躯 体前行。从1920年日本殖民时期的韩国渔村，到日本大阪，经历了二战和朝鲜战争，一直到90年代末日本泡沫经济时代的横滨和东京乃至纽约。在这样复杂的历史背景下，全剧着重描绘了几代人在家族与故乡、融入与归属、金钱与信仰等一系列问题上的关系与矛盾。
umc.cmc.17vf6g68dy89kk1l1nnb6min4.original: Based on the New York Times bestseller, this sweeping saga chronicles the hopes and dreams of a Korean immigrant family across four generations as they leave their homeland in an indomitable quest to survive and thrive.

umc.cmc.3ocr6483492qm53io2bsy2o69.text: 故事发生在波士顿，讲述绝望的父亲被迫联手一名惯犯，洗劫腐败的政客，在劫案出了岔子之后，二人在一位心理治疗师的帮助下，寻找活命的出路。
umc.cmc.3ocr6483492qm53io2bsy2o69.original: Rory and Cobby are unlikely partners: a desperate father and an ex-con thrown together for a heist. When it goes awry, they team up with an unusual accomplice—Rory’s therapist—to outrun police, backward bureaucrats, and a vengeful crime boss.

umc.cmc.2vru12c9n7324q0tdk324i0f.text: 一位联邦调查局的新特工在美国的赛马行业发现了大规模的洗钱行动，冒着生命危险抓捕罪犯：墨西哥最危险的贩毒集团。
umc.cmc.2vru12c9n7324q0tdk324i0f.original: When a rookie FBI agent uncovers a massive money laundering operation in American horse racing, he risks his life to take down the culprits: Mexico’s deadliest cartel.

umc.cmc.1oenx8mbap78we9b35c52s07s.text: 苹果将把1981年幻想喜剧片《时间劫匪》改编成剧集，塔伊加·维迪提(《雷神3》《追捕野蛮人》)执导并编写首集剧本。电影由特里·吉列姆执导，约翰·克里斯、肖恩·康纳利等主演，讲述英国少年凯文跨越多维度的疯狂故事，他发现自己的衣橱里有一个时间洞，六个小矮人从洞里出来，带着凯文开始了一系列穿越历史的冒险，他们在古希腊、中世纪、拿破仑时代和20世纪初都有过停留，而在到达终极黑暗堡垒之前，他们遇到了邪恶事物。
umc.cmc.1oenx8mbap78we9b35c52s07s.original: Eleven-year-old Kevin’s passion for history is put to the test when he joins a ragtag group of time-traveling thieves on a high-stakes and hilarious adventure in this epic reimagining of the iconic film.

umc.cmc.2j4grqjj59olekp9vdrmjtodq.text: 该剧改编自劳拉·李普曼的同名畅销小说。 1966年感恩节，一名少女的失踪席卷巴尔的摩，两名女性的生活发生了致命的碰撞。Maddie Schwartz（娜塔莉·波特曼 Natalie Portman 饰）是一位犹太裔家庭主妇，她试图摆脱自己的秘密过往，重新成为一名调查记者；Cleo Johnson（摩西·英格拉姆 Moses Ingram 饰）是一位母亲，她在巴尔的摩黑人区政治底层摸爬滚打，同时还要努力养家糊口。起初，她们迥异的生活似乎是平行无交集的，但当Maddie开始专注于Cleo令人费解的死亡时，一条裂缝便打开了，让她们周围的每个人都处于危险之中。
umc.cmc.2j4grqjj59olekp9vdrmjtodq.original: When the disappearance of a young girl grips the city of Baltimore in 1966, the lives of two women converge on a fatal collision course.

umc.cmc.3m567dtk8qcawdjwnagsr1jbs.text: 从秘鲁盐田到卢旺达咖啡林，探索并礼赞那些构建了社会、塑造了信仰并永远改变人类历史画卷的食材。由世界知名主厨勒内·雷泽皮担任旁白。
umc.cmc.3m567dtk8qcawdjwnagsr1jbs.original: From Peruvian salt flats to Rwandan coffee forests, explore and celebrate the ingredients that built societies, shaped beliefs, and forever altered the tapestry of humanity. Narrated by world-renowned chef René Redzepi.

umc.cmc.3d79cajjwbx5wsylkce31zrcz.text: 新学校。新家庭。新超能力。当12岁的本·瓦萨尼发现自己能够变成他遇到的任何人时，对他来说这是一个充满变革的季节。作为一名变形者，本必须弄清楚他是谁以及他想成为谁。
umc.cmc.3d79cajjwbx5wsylkce31zrcz.original: New school. New family. New superpower. It’s a season of change for 12-year-old Ben Vasani when he discovers that he can transform into anyone he meets. As a shapeshifter, Ben must figure out who he is and who he wants to be.

umc.cmc.7c5t9dde8dxoaxwyl5rkuw38p.text: 本剧改编自常住日本爱尔兰作家Colin O’Sullivan的小说《The Dark Manual》。 苏西（拉什达·琼斯 Rashida Jones 饰）是一位居住在日本京都的美国女性，当丈夫和儿子在一次神秘的空难中失踪，她的生活从此被颠覆。作为“安慰”，她得到了桑尼，一个由她丈夫的电子公司制造的新型家用机器人。起初，苏西对桑尼试图填补她生活中的空白感到反感，但渐渐地，她们建立了意想不到的友谊。她们一起揭开了苏西一家真实遭遇的黑暗真想，并陷入了一个苏西从不知道的危险世界。
umc.cmc.7c5t9dde8dxoaxwyl5rkuw38p.original: The life of an American woman living in Kyoto, Japan, is upended when her husband and son disappear in a mysterious plane crash. As consolation, she’s given Sunny, one of a new class of domestic robots made by her husband’s electronics company.

umc.cmc.3jchmur9er2whr7zsubfcasrv.text: 加拉（伊娃·朗格利亚饰）是一位纽约社交名媛，带着母亲和女儿在一个古朴的西班牙小镇上逃亡。加拉的新生活让她遇到了一个言行鲁莽但迷人的酒庄主人，以及深不见底的家族秘密。
umc.cmc.3jchmur9er2whr7zsubfcasrv.original: Gala (Eva Longoria) is a New York City socialite on the run in a quaint Spanish town with her mother and daughter. Gala’s new life brings her into the path of a brash but charming winery owner—and a deep well of family secrets.

umc.cmc.5hnqrhwtzt3esr7rb1wq2ppvn.text: 该剧改编自斯考特·杜罗所著同名小说，讲述芝加哥检察官办公室发生了一起可怕的谋杀案后，检察官之一拉斯蒂·萨比奇(吉伦哈尔)成了犯罪嫌疑人。在被告为维持家庭和婚姻而奋斗的过程中，探索痴迷、性、政治以及爱情的力量和局限性。 内伽饰演拉斯蒂妻子芭芭拉，是名艺术家、画廊老板和母亲，她的生活在丈夫被指控谋杀他的情妇后被颠覆了，她在处理受伤的心和破碎的婚姻时也为家人而战，并与丈夫广为人知的审判作斗争。
umc.cmc.5hnqrhwtzt3esr7rb1wq2ppvn.original: A horrific murder upends the Chicago Prosecuting Attorney’s Office when one of its own is suspected of the crime—leaving the accused (Jake Gyllenhaal) fighting to keep his family together.

umc.cmc.xvcgt6ied9s3atejpk92tv1h.text: 改编自阿诺德·洛贝尔广受喜爱的图书系列。青蛙和蟾蜍一点也不像。青蛙喜欢新的冒险。蟾蜍喜欢家的舒适。然而尽管存在种种不同，青蛙和蟾蜍总是彼此陪伴——正如最好的朋友应该做的那样。
umc.cmc.xvcgt6ied9s3atejpk92tv1h.original: Based on the beloved book series by Arnold Lobel. Frog and Toad are not at all alike. Frog likes new adventures. Toad likes the comforts of home. Yet despite their differences, Frog and Toad are always there for each other—as best friends should be.

umc.cmc.5067l9fz7usyhgjfbzy6ib0na.text: 追随著名的黑豹党的领导人【休伊·P·牛顿】的一生。在《逍遥骑士》背后的好莱坞制片人伯特·施奈德（Bert Schneider）以及其他一些名人激进分子的帮助下，他逃到了古巴，以避免因谋杀罪被起诉。
umc.cmc.5067l9fz7usyhgjfbzy6ib0na.original: Black Panther Party co-founder Huey P. Newton enlists an unlikely ally—Hollywood producer Bert Schneider—to elude an FBI manhunt and escape to Cuba.

umc.cmc.117umbbiymiqrowvu6xsqzju4.text: 一个被称为“骗局女王”的神秘人物一直在好莱坞冒充有权势的女性高管，以改变人生的职业机会为承诺诱捕受害者。一名记者和一名私家侦探开始寻找这场骗局背后的罪魁祸首。
umc.cmc.117umbbiymiqrowvu6xsqzju4.original: A mysterious figure—known as the Con Queen—is impersonating powerful female executives in Hollywood, luring victims with the promise of life-changing career opportunities. A journalist and a private investigator set out to find the culprit behind the scam.

umc.cmc.2rjxcljdjz4h47vjdxnytcn23.text: 当一台神秘机器出现并承诺揭示每个人的真正潜力时，一个小镇永远改变了。不久之后，居民们开始更换工作、重新思考人际关系并质疑长期持有的信念——这一切都是为了追求更好的未来。
umc.cmc.2rjxcljdjz4h47vjdxnytcn23.original: A small town is forever changed when a mysterious machine appears, promising to reveal everyone’s true potential. Soon residents start changing jobs, rethinking relationships, and questioning long-held beliefs—all in pursuit of a better future.

umc.cmc.3qy6j44hfqtekx6fx3yzh9w8i.text: 影片围绕间谍小说作家叶利·康韦（布莱丝·达拉斯·霍华德 Bryce Dallas Howard 饰）的作品展开。叶利的小说讲述神秘特工阿盖尔（亨利·卡维尔 Henry Cavill 饰）及其瓦解全球间谍集团的任务，而小说中的情节却意外开始与真实间谍组织的秘密行动出现惊人 的一致。在特工艾登（山姆·洛克威尔 Sam Rockwell 饰）的陪同下，叶利带着猫咪阿尔菲（Chip 饰）穿越世界，竭力赶在间谍组织的杀手们行动之前化解危机，此时小说的虚构世界与现实之间的界限开始变得模糊不清。随之而来的是一场跨越全球的冒险。
umc.cmc.3qy6j44hfqtekx6fx3yzh9w8i.original: When the plots of her books get too close to the activities of a sinister underground syndicate, introverted spy novelist Elly Conway and her cat are plunged into the real world of espionage—where nothing, and no one, is what it seems.

umc.cmc.6etw1ja7p37ygnpdttyy4nryc.text: 1776年12月，本杰明·富兰克林因其电学实验而闻名于世。然而，当他踏上一项前往法国的秘密任务时，他的激情和能力受到了考验，而美国独立的命运也悬于一线。
umc.cmc.6etw1ja7p37ygnpdttyy4nryc.original: In December 1776, Benjamin Franklin is world-famous for his electrical experiments. But his passion and power are put to the test when he embarks on a secret mission to France—with the fate of American independence hanging in the balance.

umc.cmc.7fsw9p5hdoagfd4lajhf6a5li.text: 美国民主掌握在少女手中会是什么样子？在这部纪录片中，来自密苏里州背景迥异的年轻女性领导者们进行一次身临其境的实验，从头开始建立一个政府。
umc.cmc.7fsw9p5hdoagfd4lajhf6a5li.original: What would American democracy look like in the hands of teenage girls? In this documentary, young female leaders from wildly different backgrounds in Missouri navigate an immersive experiment to build a government from the ground up.

umc.cmc.2r077021gw7fu0noml0hln2yq.text: 吉姆·汉森那些热爱欢乐、音乐的弗吉尔人回来了！加入高博、雷德、温布利、莫基、布伯以及新的弗吉尔朋友们的行列，开启欢闹而壮丽的冒险，领略当我们庆祝并关爱我们相互连接的世界时所发生的奇迹。
umc.cmc.2r077021gw7fu0noml0hln2yq.original: Jim Henson’s fun-loving, musical Fraggles are back! Join Gobo, Red, Wembley, Mokey, Boober, and new Fraggle friends on hilarious, epic adventures about the magic that happens when we celebrate and care for our interconnected world.

umc.cmc.7kkgskd7j0lomjoqdo97l80ql.text: 史蒂夫·马丁是娱乐界最受喜爱且最神秘的人物之一。从过去和现在这两个不同的视角，深入了解他非凡的故事，马丁反思了他的起点是如何引领他走向今天意想不到的充实生活的。
umc.cmc.7kkgskd7j0lomjoqdo97l80ql.original: Steve Martin is one of the most beloved and enigmatic figures in entertainment. Dive into his extraordinary story from two distinct points of view—past and present—as Martin reflects on how his beginnings led to his unexpectedly fulfilling life today.

umc.cmc.17tiu47xvxo1p9k0tqfvhf29r.text: 聚焦于《空战群英》中几个人物和现实飞行员的真实故事。从珍珠港事件的震惊到欧洲胜利日的喜悦，《血腥百人》记录了一群年轻的美国人民在国家和世界最需要他们的时候所经历的一切和取得的成就。
umc.cmc.17tiu47xvxo1p9k0tqfvhf29r.original: Meet the real-life airmen who inspired Masters of the Air as they share the harrowing and transformative events of the 100th Bomb Group. Narrated by Tom Hanks and featuring Steven Spielberg.

umc.cmc.25k80oxl3vo69c8rimk8v81s1.text: 影片讲述了法国皇帝拿破仑（华金·菲尼克斯 Joaquin Phoenix 饰）从士兵到帝王波澜壮阔的一生，展现了拿破仑非凡的军事才能和战略远见。并通过他与其唯一挚爱约瑟芬（凡妮莎·柯比 Vanessa Kirby 饰）之间复杂纠葛的传奇情史，揭露了拿破仑鲜为人知的内心世界。
umc.cmc.25k80oxl3vo69c8rimk8v81s1.original: A personal look at the French military leader’s origins and swift, ruthless climb to emperor. The story is viewed through the prism of Napoleon’s addictive, volatile relationship with his wife and one true love, Josephine.

umc.cmc.37r7vskzmm8hk2pfbzaxlcwzg.text: 传奇江洋大盗迪克·特平被迫成为一帮逃犯的不情愿领袖，并肩负着智胜极其腐败的执法官乔纳森·维尔德的任务，从而开启了一系列极度荒诞的奇遇。
umc.cmc.37r7vskzmm8hk2pfbzaxlcwzg.original: Legendary highwayman Dick Turpin sets out on a series of wildly absurd escapades when he’s made the reluctant leader of a band of outlaws—and tasked with outwitting utterly corrupt lawman Jonathan Wilde.

umc.cmc.3lvo8a7ezxpysdy3gou3fsns0.text: 一场太空灾难后，Jo（劳米·拉佩斯 Noomi Rapace 饰）返回了地球，但她发现自己生活中的关键部分似乎不见了。而Henry（乔纳森·班克斯 Jonathan Banks 饰），一位荣获诺贝尔奖的物理学家，他的秘密发现的答案由国际空间站上的Jo保密……直到她归来了。 这部充满动作戏的太空冒险剧集，是对人类心理黑暗边缘的探索，展现了一位女性不顾一切地寻求揭露太空旅行背后隐藏历史的真相，并找回她失去的一切。
umc.cmc.3lvo8a7ezxpysdy3gou3fsns0.original: When a fatal accident occurs on board the International Space Station, a lone astronaut makes the heroic journey back to Earth, only to discover key pieces of her life—including her young daughter—have changed.

umc.cmc.6hpxli71tx1zy1mwz7tutj94h.text: 该剧共4集，包括这名七获金球奖的足球球员的“独家幕后影像”，在巴黎、卡塔尔和阿根廷等地拍摄，回顾梅西的五次世界杯之旅，尤其是制作组全程跟随了的他2022年的捧杯。梅西也将亲口讲述他在阿根廷国家队的经历，“以亲密且前所未有的视角来展现一趟定义传奇的世界杯胜利之旅”，也有与他的队友、教练、对手、球迷、解说员们的采访。
umc.cmc.6hpxli71tx1zy1mwz7tutj94h.original: Follow the legend’s epic journey through five World Cups, culminating in 2022’s triumph. As the championship run unfolds, Messi shares some of his most personal reflections—on his national team career and the challenges he’s faced.

umc.cmc.e399kebej378s053scn8nghf.text: 深入了解美国橄榄球新英格兰爱国者队20年的历程，从独特的相互配合而拿下六次超级碗冠军，到内哄引发的你争我夺。汤姆·布雷迪、比尔·贝利奇克、罗伯特·卡夫与关键球员将揭晓成就伟大的过程与代价。
umc.cmc.e399kebej378s053scn8nghf.original: Go inside the franchise’s 20-year journey, from the unique chemistry that fueled six Super Bowl wins to the internal strife that sparked a turf war. Tom Brady, Bill Belichick, Robert Kraft, and key players reveal the road to—and cost of—greatness.

umc.cmc.6m0i5dcn60uzl206qq6ibomeh.text: 剧名来自迪奥载入史册的女装新款式“新风貌”。故事受真实事件启发，聚焦时装设计师克里斯汀·迪奥和可可·香奈儿的竞争关系。克里斯汀·迪奥在二战期间迅速崛起，其具有创新的标志性风格，使世界重新焕发生机。 除了二战后统治全球时尚数十年的迪奥，和香奈儿之外，这部交织传 奇故事还将包括其他迪奥同代人和竞争对手的故事：皮埃尔·巴尔曼（Balmain）、克里斯托瓦尔·巴伦西亚加（Balenciaga）、贝尔·德·纪梵希（Givenchy）、皮尔·卡丹（Pierre Cardin）、伊夫·圣罗兰（Yves Saint Laurent）等。
umc.cmc.6m0i5dcn60uzl206qq6ibomeh.original: This thrilling series reveals the shocking story of how fashion icon Christian Dior and his contemporaries including Coco Chanel, Pierre Balmain, and Cristóbal Balenciaga navigated the horrors of World War Il and launched modern fashion.

umc.cmc.7bxcni0vwgll9kmicq738k5q2.text: 该剧是继《兄弟连》和《太平洋战争》之后，史蒂文·斯皮尔伯格和汤姆·汉克斯打造的“二战三部曲”第三部。 聚焦美空军第8航空队在二战期间空炸德国的故事，第100轰炸机大队的空军士兵冒着生命危险出生入死，他们凭着勇气、牺牲和胜利锻造出一段兄弟情谊。
umc.cmc.7bxcni0vwgll9kmicq738k5q2.original: From Steven Spielberg, Tom Hanks, and Gary Goetzman—the producers of Band of Brothers and The Pacific. During World War II, airmen risk their lives with the 100th Bomb Group, a brotherhood forged by courage, loss, and triumph.

umc.cmc.5x1fg9vferlfeutzpq6rra1zf.text: 印第安人的一支欧塞奇族，从祖先的土地上被驱逐到了美国俄克拉何马州一块贫瘠之地，谁曾想这里居然发现了石油。欧塞奇人借此一跃成为时尚新贵的同时，也给自身带来了杀机。在此之后，许多白人涌入这片流淌着黑金的土地，不择手段攫取利益。一战退伍兵欧内斯特（莱昂纳多·迪卡普里奥 Leonardo DiCaprio 饰）为了生计辗转来此，投奔已经贵为名流舅舅威廉·黑尔（罗伯特·德尼罗 Robert De Niro 饰）。威廉和原住民关系密切，黑白通吃，然而和善的外表下包藏着贪婪的蛇蝎之心。他暗示欧内斯特追求富有的印第安女子莫莉（莉莉·格莱斯顿 Lily Gladstone 饰），而真正觊觎的则是她们家族所拥有的财富。短短数年间，数十名印第安人意外身亡。君子无罪，怀璧其罪…… 本片根据大卫·格兰的畅销著作改编。
umc.cmc.5x1fg9vferlfeutzpq6rra1zf.original: When oil is discovered in 1920s Oklahoma under Osage Nation land, the Osage people are murdered one by one—until the FBI steps in to unravel the mystery.

umc.cmc.bbgldczdqayqjyllxp43v6a4.text: 约翰·列农生命中和死讯中的关键人物——包括朋友、医生和调查人员——有史以来第一次分享个人记忆，并揭示了他遇害当晚发生的事情。
umc.cmc.bbgldczdqayqjyllxp43v6a4.original: For the first time, key figures from John Lennon’s life and death—including friends, doctors, and investigators—share personal memories and reveal what happened on the night of his killing.

umc.cmc.33t5cskiqmmft1hxp23w9gnbw.text: 通过在事件展开时屋内录制的原始音频录音，体验世界上最著名的骚灵案件令人毛骨悚然的真实故事。
umc.cmc.33t5cskiqmmft1hxp23w9gnbw.original: Experience the chilling true story of the world’s most famous poltergeist case through original audio recordings made inside the house as the events unfolded.

umc.cmc.40yycssgxelw4zur8m2ilmvyx.text: 本剧改编自作家、科学编辑兼广告撰稿人邦妮·加默斯的同名小说。 故事发生在1950年代早期，当时的社会普遍认为女性属于家庭而非职业领域。Elizabeth Zott（布丽·拉尔森 Brie Larson 饰）渴望在一个由男性主导的世界里成为一名科学家。她就职于一 家实验室，是知名科学家Calvin Evans（刘易斯·普尔曼 Lewis Pullman 饰）的助手，两人之间有着非同寻常的化学反应。然而，随着Elizabeth发现自己怀有身孕、孤身一人，还被实验室开除，她搁置了自己的梦想，同时也被激发出了单身母亲独有的聪明才智。Elizabeth接受了一份在电视烹饪节目当主持人的工作，并开始教导一个国家被忽视的家庭主妇们和那些突然用心倾听的男性很多食谱之外的知识，也一直渴望着回到自己真正喜爱的领域：科学。
umc.cmc.40yycssgxelw4zur8m2ilmvyx.original: In the 1950s, Elizabeth Zott’s dream of being a scientist is challenged by a society that says women belong in the domestic sphere. She accepts a job on a TV cooking show and sets out to teach a nation of overlooked housewives way more than recipes.

umc.cmc.es6c1ptzxayqb3njj21diwhm.text: 与梅西一起开启他历史性的下一个人生章节，席卷北美地区和美国职业足球大联盟，并与迈阿密国际队的队友们一起开创足球运动的新时代。
umc.cmc.es6c1ptzxayqb3njj21diwhm.original: Join Lionel Messi as he embarks on his historic next chapter—taking North America and Major League Soccer by storm, and ushering in a new era of the game with his Inter Miami CF teammates.

umc.cmc.1ol2idv8q2iftiyjfkuyfki5l.text: 弗洛拉（伊芙·休森 Eve Hewson 饰）是一位住在都柏林的年轻母亲，很久以前就失去了抱负，在努力抚养儿子麦克斯（奥伦·金兰 Orén Kinlan 饰）的同时，她要兼顾一份维持生计的托儿工作，并与不友善的前任进行令人忧虑的共同抚养孩子的安排。 母子俩关系紧张，在相互理解的过程中挣扎，弗洛拉伪装成自私之人来寻求自主和自爱，麦克斯渴望独立和自我表达 ，走上了犯罪之路，成为一个小偷。 警察鼓励弗洛拉为麦克斯寻找一门爱好，弗洛拉送给儿子一把被丢弃的二手吉他作为生日礼物，但被后者拒绝，她决定自己通过Zoom向一位热爱音乐的老师学习。在母子两人建立关系的过程中，麦克斯自己的音乐天赋显露出来，音乐将让生活重新充满活力，唤醒沉睡已久的梦想，并让孤立环境成长的人建立新的联系。
umc.cmc.1ol2idv8q2iftiyjfkuyfki5l.original: Single mom Flora is at a loss about what to do with her rebellious teenage son, Max. Her efforts to keep him out of trouble lead to a beat-up acoustic guitar, a washed-up LA musician, and harmony for this frayed Dublin family.

umc.cmc.18gr0rhyi18lt79vgtw794wcw.text: 当故事情节需要一点趣味时，派珀和她的想象力就能帮你扭转乾坤。该剧改编自大卫·埃兹拉·斯坦的获奖儿童读物系列，讲述派珀和她的朋友们在《打断鸡》中展开冒险的故事，将于 11 月 18 日在 Apple TV+ 独家首播。
umc.cmc.18gr0rhyi18lt79vgtw794wcw.original: Little red chicken Piper is a budding writer who uses her big imagination to rewrite stories, jumping into the action to create unforgettable adventures. Based on David Ezra Stein’s best-selling, award-winning children’s book series.

umc.cmc.4sn9yh0gys8gpb0yei0h443a1.text: 因为失眠而紧密相连，挚友丽莎和丹尼在深夜保持联系，并在他们的关系加深的同时，在一个充满奇妙诡异惊喜的世界中寻找出路。
umc.cmc.4sn9yh0gys8gpb0yei0h443a1.original: Bonded by insomnia, best friends Lisa and Danny stay connected to each other late into the night and find their way through a world of wonderfully weird surprises as their relationship deepens.

umc.cmc.1jvelve41wn4nv2fl4v2u8rgj.text: 1980年代，娜奥米·坎贝尔、辛迪·克劳馥、琳达·伊万格丽斯塔和克里斯蒂·特林顿成了时尚指标人物，接着她们联手出击，超越了时尚产业。她们的声望是如此非凡，以至于这四个人能够取代她们展示的品牌，使她们的名字与设计师一样出名。 如今，这四位超模通过积极行动、慈善事业和商业才能，依然站在文化的前沿。随着时尚产业不断重新定义自身——以及女性在其中的角色——这是一个关于权力的终极故事，讲述了四位女性如何齐心协力争取权力，为后来者铺平道路。
umc.cmc.1jvelve41wn4nv2fl4v2u8rgj.original: In the ‘80s, Naomi Campbell, Cindy Crawford, Linda Evangelista, and Christy Turlington became fashion icons—then transcended their industry by uniting. This is the story of how they claimed their power and shaped the world that followed.

umc.cmc.161vwm570k49vsn7xjtzvnwex.text: 阿波罗和艾玛的爱情故事宛如童话，直到艾玛神秘失踪。悲痛欲绝的阿波罗发现自己踏上了一场九死一生的奥德赛之旅，穿梭于一个他从未知道其存在的纽约市。改编自获奖小说。
umc.cmc.161vwm570k49vsn7xjtzvnwex.original: Apollo and Emma’s love story is a fairy tale—until Emma mysteriously vanishes. Bereft, Apollo finds himself on a death-defying odyssey through a New York City he didn’t know existed. Based on the award-winning novel.

umc.cmc.34nvp6vc5in9logmjc7hezp52.text: 关于由首席执行官沦为逃犯的卡洛斯·戈恩的引人入胜的故事，包括他权倾朝野的统治、令人震惊的逮捕，以及震惊世界的精心策划的逃亡。
umc.cmc.34nvp6vc5in9logmjc7hezp52.original: The riveting story of CEO-turned-fugitive Carlos Ghosn, including his reign of power, shocking arrest, and calculated getaway that stunned the world.

umc.cmc.zbh4nvi65qy3os9ifxm0fpe4.text: 欢迎来到一个与我们自己的星球相去不远遥远星球，这里有关于生活、爱情和友谊的爆笑而又辛酸的观察——以最奇特的方式讲述。由创作者内森·W·派尔和丹·哈蒙倾力打造。
umc.cmc.zbh4nvi65qy3os9ifxm0fpe4.original: Welcome to a distant planet not unlike our own, with hilarious yet poignant observations on life, love, and friendship—told in the most peculiar way. From creators Nathan W. Pyle and Dan Harmon.

umc.cmc.6gdc6v4vwyaab7klocftv2s10.text: 1980年代南加州的海滩社区，一个遭受折磨的家庭主妇（罗丝·伯恩 饰）寻找到了一条非常规的改变之路——踏入健美操的世界。
umc.cmc.6gdc6v4vwyaab7klocftv2s10.original: Sheila Rubin is a quietly tormented housewife in ’80s San Diego. Behind closed doors, she battles extreme personal demons and a vicious inner voice. But things change when she discovers aerobics, sparking a journey toward empowerment and success.

umc.cmc.4byzgw44377yxyjsl85rhn8vq.text: 泰曾是一个郁郁不得志的玩具推销员，直到他与三名女性合作，将他的毛绒玩具变成了90年代的标志性潮流。这部幕后纪录片展现了历史上最大的玩具狂热，是一个关于这个世界如何对事物和人进行估价的疯狂故事。
umc.cmc.4byzgw44377yxyjsl85rhn8vq.original: Ty was a frustrated toy salesman until his collaboration with three women turned his stuffed animals into a defining ’90s trend. This behind-the-scenes look at history’s biggest toy craze is a wild story about what—and who—is valued in this world.

umc.cmc.23v0wxaiwz60bjy1w4vg7npun.text: 聚焦库里的篮球之路，也将回顾他2008年带领戴维森学院在NCAA技惊四座的表现。 “爆发力和运动能力远远低于NBA标准，对于NBA控球后卫位置，身高6尺2寸的他体型极小，不要倚仗他带领你的球队运转。有可能浪投、强投，不适应太大的针对性防守强度，因为体型和身体素质的关系，不是一个好的篮下终结者。上半身需要增肌，但看起来会一直瘦削下去。”——同样身为传奇投手的雷吉·米勒介绍，这是库里当时的选秀报告。然而，在他从此进入NBA后……
umc.cmc.23v0wxaiwz60bjy1w4vg7npun.original: The remarkable coming-of-age story of Stephen Curry—one of the most influential, dynamic, and unexpected players in basketball history—and his rise from an undersized college player to a four-time NBA champion.

umc.cmc.5wg8cnigwrkfzbdruaufzb6b0.text: 在这部爆笑的谋杀悬疑剧中，一切似乎都并非表面那样，每个嫌疑人的故事都通过不同的流派来讲述。
umc.cmc.5wg8cnigwrkfzbdruaufzb6b0.original: Nothing is as it seems in this hilarious murder mystery where each suspect’s story is told through a different genre.

umc.cmc.63e208601mwndrxpmguc5stbo.text: 由NBA球星凯文·杜兰特、电影制作人雷吉·洛克·拜斯伍德以及《胜利之光》幕后团队倾情打造。一名篮球神童必须穿过重重压力的迷宫，才能战胜逆境，并领悟到真正拥有自信与风范的含义。
umc.cmc.63e208601mwndrxpmguc5stbo.original: From NBA star Kevin Durant, filmmaker Reggie Rock Bythewood, and the team behind Friday Night Lights. A basketball prodigy must navigate a maze of pressure if he’s going to overcome the odds against him and learn what it truly means to have swagger.

umc.cmc.5iswprrvjjw6ab020a17x4ca3.text: 全球最具知名度的狗狗，即将成为镁光灯焦点！现在就和这只喜欢开心跳舞、想飞上蓝天和充满梦想的比格犬，还有它最好的朋友糊涂塌客，以及《花生漫画》的其他伙伴一起展开新的冒险吧！
umc.cmc.5iswprrvjjw6ab020a17x4ca3.original: The world’s most iconic dog is ready for his close-up. Dive into new adventures with the happy-dancing, high-flying, big-dreaming beagle, who’s joined by best friend Woodstock and the rest of the Peanuts gang.

umc.cmc.495pmjg441gg3j70j3x2yufx9.text: 一部以1979年夏天曼哈顿为背景的心理惊悚片，当时一名年轻男子因一起令人震惊的罪行被捕——而一位意想不到的调查员必须解开背后的谜团。
umc.cmc.495pmjg441gg3j70j3x2yufx9.original: A psychological thriller set in Manhattan in the summer of 1979, when a young man is arrested for a shocking crime—and an unlikely investigator must solve the mystery behind it.

umc.cmc.1c4fnxk415p7l3eumcqholxn8.text: 佩吉·纽曼有着一段斑驳的过去，在与她同住在加利福尼亚州尤卡瓦利沙漠小镇的慈母去世后，她做出了改变一生的决定，成为了一名私家侦探。
umc.cmc.1c4fnxk415p7l3eumcqholxn8.original: Peggy Newman, a woman with a checkered past, makes the life-changing decision to become a private investigator following the death of her beloved mother, who she lived with in the small desert town of Yucca Valley, California.

umc.cmc.r6vntb5r9wwbjwtt58xmyuz9.text: 2003年7月4日，一名大学生在中央公园中枪。调查将一系列神秘的全市火灾、市中心音乐场景以及一个在众多秘密重压下分崩离析的富裕上城房地产家族串联在了一起。
umc.cmc.r6vntb5r9wwbjwtt58xmyuz9.original: A college student is shot in Central Park on July 4, 2003. The investigation connects a series of mysterious citywide fires, the downtown music scene, and a wealthy uptown real estate family fraying under the strain of the many secrets they keep.

umc.cmc.3gx9h3d2f823gl8pvpippy5p9.text: 一个好奇的11岁女孩，为了成为职业作家，她寻求了解一切。
umc.cmc.3gx9h3d2f823gl8pvpippy5p9.original: Outspoken and perpetually curious. That’s 11-year-old Harriet in a nutshell. But if she’s going to be Harriet M. Welsch, future writer, she’ll need to know everything. And to know everything means she’ll need to spy…on everyone.

umc.cmc.7d9yulmth1rvkwpij477qsqsk.text: 从冰冻极地到热带雨林，认识自然界最迷人的巨兽，它们证明了庞大体型也会带来巨大挑战。
umc.cmc.7d9yulmth1rvkwpij477qsqsk.original: Travel from freezing poles to tropical rainforests to meet nature’s most captivating giants, who prove being big comes with enormous challenges. Narrated by Tom Hiddleston.

umc.cmc.nrpql3y16pqdot7foyan3z52.text: 深入剖析网球名将鲍里斯·贝克尔备受争议的生活与职业生涯——其中包含对约翰·麦肯罗、诺瓦克·德约科维奇、比约恩·博格及其他偶像人物的采访。
umc.cmc.nrpql3y16pqdot7foyan3z52.original: An inside look at the controversial life and career of tennis great Boris Becker—featuring interviews with John McEnroe, Novak Djokovic, Björn Borg, and other icons.

umc.cmc.1tqmf2znhr4oui4vo69ircyui.text: 乔希和梅丽莎是一对生活困顿的情侣，当他们被困在一个充满魔力的音乐小镇，并肩负必须完成的任务时，他们的生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。
umc.cmc.1tqmf2znhr4oui4vo69ircyui.original: Josh and Melissa are a struggling couple whose lives are transformed when they get trapped in a magical musical town—with a mission they must complete.

umc.cmc.4evmgcam356pzgxs2l7a18d7b.text: 影片改编自知名电子游戏《俄罗斯方块》的著作权争夺。在1980年代末期，防弹软件的荷兰游戏设计师亨克·罗杰斯（塔伦·埃哲顿 Taron Egerton 饰）为了获得“俄罗斯方块”的版权，深入冷战时期的苏联，与苏联当局进行谈判。
umc.cmc.4evmgcam356pzgxs2l7a18d7b.original: Based on the true story of American video game salesman Henk Rogers (Taron Egerton) and his discovery of Tetris in 1988. When he sets out to bring the game to the world, he enters a dangerous web of lies and corruption behind the Iron Curtain.

umc.cmc.k3xdiqrkcoln2fa2ikksndt0.text: 瑞茜·威瑟斯彭和凯茜·马斯格雷夫斯携手吉米·艾伦、米奇·盖顿和奥维尔·佩克，在一档全新类型的竞技节目中在全球范围内寻找乡村音乐的下一个巨星。
umc.cmc.k3xdiqrkcoln2fa2ikksndt0.original: Reese Witherspoon and Kacey Musgraves join Jimmie Allen, Mickey Guyton, and Orville Peck on a global search for country music’s next big star in a new kind of competition series.

umc.cmc.4uoqxmxlnipm9zsc88bkjyjx4.text: Apple TV+预定气候变化题材诗选类剧集《外推》。 本剧来自《秘密特工》编剧Scott Z. Burns，他将担任编剧、导演和执行制片。 剧集会讲述私人且意料之外的故事，地球面临的变化是如何在个人和人类层面影响着我们的爱、信仰、工作及家庭。通过8集有内在关联的故事呈现，每个故事都将追踪21世纪以来，世界各地为了我们共同生存而进行的斗争。
umc.cmc.4uoqxmxlnipm9zsc88bkjyjx4.original: Eight interconnected stories told over 33 years explore how our planet’s changing climate will affect family, work, faith—and survival.

umc.cmc.38kf4x2lvqiqdb0up8kcptnd.text: 该剧讲聚焦职业摔角培训机构「怪物工厂」，讲五个摔角手努力进入WWE的故事。
umc.cmc.38kf4x2lvqiqdb0up8kcptnd.original: Welcome to The World Famous Monster Factory, a school where spandex-clad misfits escape the confines of everyday life to chase the dream of going pro.

umc.cmc.39sq1w84s2idx8xyyrpxrl89a.text: 踏上球场，走入这支标志性足球队的幕后，回顾他们令人惊叹的 2021–2022 赛季。在狂热球迷的支持下，他们逆势而上，让怀疑者闭嘴。
umc.cmc.39sq1w84s2idx8xyyrpxrl89a.original: Step onto the field and go behind the scenes with the iconic soccer team for a look at their astonishing 2021–2022 season. Fueled by their fervent fans, they defy the odds and silence the skeptics.

umc.cmc.4fcexvzqezr25p9weks6sxpob.text: 乔恩·斯图尔特带着他标志性的幽默，剖析美国最顽疾难除的问题，试图与身居最高权力层的人士共同寻找解决方案……前提是他们愿意接听他的电话。
umc.cmc.4fcexvzqezr25p9weks6sxpob.original: Wielding his signature humor, Jon Stewart walks through America’s most persistent problems to find solutions with people at the highest levels of power...if they’d only return his calls.

umc.cmc.62t13xacr3mxnit5a40g8tkla.text: 两名特工（也是昔日恋人）必须携手合作，打击威胁英国的国际网络攻击，同时正视他们那段充满破坏性的关系中深埋的秘密。
umc.cmc.62t13xacr3mxnit5a40g8tkla.original: Two agents—and former lovers—must work together to combat international cyberattacks threatening the UK while also confronting the buried secrets of their destructive relationship.

umc.cmc.kpgzlz0lejug1vhtakgizdlh.text: 认识一下普雷策尔，世界上身材最长的腊肠犬，也是五只活泼可爱的小狗贪玩而又支持它们的爸爸。他和妻子格蕾塔一起，鼓励小狗们伸出爪子去解决问题，并在世界上“发出他们的吠声”留下印记。
umc.cmc.kpgzlz0lejug1vhtakgizdlh.original: Meet Pretzel, the world’s longest dachshund and a playful, supportive dad to five frisky puppies. Together with his wife, Greta, they encourage their pups to get their paws up to solve problems and “make their bark” on the world.

umc.cmc.6lknbhv5dcfx8lfe8ghqmy4ma.text: 在一个复古未来主义的世界里，极具魅力的推销员杰克·比林斯（艾美奖®得主比利·克鲁德普饰）带领着一群销售同事，决心通过兜售月球分时度假房来重振顾客的生活。
umc.cmc.6lknbhv5dcfx8lfe8ghqmy4ma.original: In a retro-futuristic world, charismatic salesman Jack Billings (Emmy® winner Billy Crudup) leads a team of fellow sales associates determined to revitalize their customers’ lives by hawking timeshares on the moon.

umc.cmc.6oubrn858v7d76sut4mx52i3x.text: 深入职业冲浪世界，看这项运动中最顶尖的选手环游全球，争夺世界冠军头衔。这部纪录片剧集拥有前所未有的拍摄权限，记录了运动员们在巡回赛中的生活，以及他们为登顶所做出的牺牲。
umc.cmc.6oubrn858v7d76sut4mx52i3x.original: Dive into the world of pro surfing as the best in the sport travel the globe to compete for the World Championship title. With unprecedented access, this docuseries captures the athletes’ lives on tour and the sacrifices they make to get to the top.

umc.cmc.2rp99884b0rpc42alv86h960b.text: 由费舍尔·史蒂文斯执导，科林·奥布莱恩、康妮·布里顿、泰勒·席林主演的苹果 Apple TV+ 原创剧，根据美国作家安·纳波利塔诺在2020年发布的同名小说改编。它讲述了一个 12 岁男孩的故事，他是飞机失事的唯一幸存者，飞机失事导致其他 191 名乘客死亡，其中包括主角的家人。
umc.cmc.2rp99884b0rpc42alv86h960b.original: A 12-year-old boy becomes the lone survivor of a plane crash. As he and others affected by the tragedy try to make sense of what happened, unexpected friendships, romances, and communities are formed.

umc.cmc.2jwlalsi34m25fcfljpvk990r.text: 凯特·比顿备受喜爱的图书在这部动画剧集中焕发生机。作为一名训练中的勇士，派恩科恩无所畏惧。好在小马总能确保派恩科恩不会自不量力。他们一起了解到，生活可以是一场充满乐趣的冒险。
umc.cmc.2jwlalsi34m25fcfljpvk990r.original: Kate Beaton’s beloved book comes to life in this animated series. As a warrior in training, Pinecone fears no challenge. Thankfully, Pony always makes sure Pinecone never gets in over her head. Together they learn life can be a fun-filled adventure.

umc.cmc.6hegr60w8pjyfcblgocjek7oo.text: 欢迎走进iTunes大热真实罪案播客的台前幕后。 19年前关于伯曼入室谋杀案的两篇调查报道，让时任《纽约时报》记者波碧·帕内尔（屋大维娅·斯宾塞 饰）声名大噪。现如今面对受害人女儿证词受人教导的新证据，主持热门真实罪案播客的她良心难泯决定重启调查——当年17岁入狱服刑至今的沃伦·凯夫（亚伦·保罗 饰）到底是否真如其母所说的那样清白无辜蒙冤受过？
umc.cmc.6hegr60w8pjyfcblgocjek7oo.original: Descend into the world of true-crime podcasts. This NAACP Image Award–winning drama stars Octavia Spencer as a podcaster who risks everything—including her life—to pursue truth and justice.

umc.cmc.744k10sqewo1m6taxvt8rcnhy.text: 足球的过去、现在和未来因为分离联赛计画的出现而发生了衝撞。这项运动中最有权势的领导人们得捍卫或颠覆这项运动的传统。
umc.cmc.744k10sqewo1m6taxvt8rcnhy.original: The past, present, and future of European football collide when plans for a breakaway league emerge, leaving the game’s most powerful leaders to defend—or upend—the traditions of the sport.

umc.cmc.4y25wuby7pck9o6vaubbbk7gb.text: 讲述一对夫妻因其幼小的孩子死去，十分伤心，婚姻也出现裂痕，妻子把一个假娃娃养在家里，还请了保姆，家中却发生了神秘的事：找来的小保姆也把这个孩子当成活的婴儿一般对待，更多怪事发生……到底该信故事的哪一个版本？
umc.cmc.4y25wuby7pck9o6vaubbbk7gb.original: From M. Night Shyamalan, Servant follows a Philadelphia couple in mourning after an unspeakable tragedy creates a rift in their marriage and opens the door for a mysterious force to enter their home.

umc.cmc.kfh7cellb1a3dmiehxhvq8gl.text: 认识科迪和“帮手怪”，这是一支热爱解决问题的充满活力的怪兽小队。无论是策划派对、爬山还是精通魔术，“帮手怪”都能想出办法——因为一切都始于一个计划。
umc.cmc.kfh7cellb1a3dmiehxhvq8gl.original: Meet Cody and the Helpsters, a team of vibrant monsters who love to solve problems. Whether it’s planning a party, climbing a mountain, or mastering a magic trick, the Helpsters can figure anything out—because everything starts with a plan.

umc.cmc.2aenzye90tqkj7iy0131oom9x.text: 查理·麦克西的同名绘本改编的手绘动画，关于善良、友谊、勇气和希望，通过一段辛酸而真挚的旅程，讲述了一个男孩、一只鼹鼠、一只狐狸和一匹马，四个孤独的灵魂在寻找家的过程中结伴而行，并在彼此身上找到了自己存在的意义。
umc.cmc.2aenzye90tqkj7iy0131oom9x.original: 2023 Oscar® winner: Best Animated Short Film. Charlie Mackesy’s bestseller comes to life in this beautifully animated film from NoneMore and Bad Robot Productions. Follow the unlikely bond between four friends on their journey to find home.

umc.cmc.1j6fdxookwtqml3bd8ivvcbbv.text: 威尔·史密斯饰演真实历史人物：饱受折磨后逃出美国南方奴隶主奴役的黑人彼得、美国奴隶制的著名“证据”照片的主人公。 影片风格被描述为比起《为奴十二年》，更像梅尔·吉布森执导的《启示录》，Willam N. Collage写剧本，故事来自彼得的真实经历：他从奴隶主手中逃出，忍受着冷血的猎人的追杀和路易斯安那州危险的沼泽，一路向北。而当逃到北方军中，接受检查时，彼得露出了自己被种植园中的监工鞭笞得累累伤痕的后背。这一幕被拍成了著名的照片“被鞭打的脊背”(the scourged back)，刊登在1863年5月的《Independent》，以及当年7月4日的《Harper’s Weekly》。该照片成为美国奴隶制残忍暴行的证据之一，发布后推动了废奴运动和促使许多自由的黑人加入联邦军，并流传到世界各地，传言称这张照片使得法国等国家拒绝从美国南方购买棉花。
umc.cmc.1j6fdxookwtqml3bd8ivvcbbv.original: Inspired by the gripping true story of a man who would do anything for his family—and for freedom. When Peter, an enslaved man, risks his life to escape and return to his family, he embarks on a perilous journey of love and endurance.

umc.cmc.2ice8mlcn1zrtxf81e5ktwg8p.text: Apple TV+宣布成长诗选喜剧《小美国 Little America》将于20年1月17日上线，这部剧改编自Epic杂志里的真实故事，讲述美国移民们的幽默﹑浪漫﹑诚挚﹑令人惊讶的故事。 主演包括Zachary Quinto﹑Haaz Sleiman﹑Meìlanie Laurent﹑Shaun Toub﹑Conphidance及Sherlilyn Fenn，本剧已续订第二季。
umc.cmc.2ice8mlcn1zrtxf81e5ktwg8p.original: From the director and Oscar®-winning writer of CODA, Little America is an anthology series that observes the funny, romantic, heartfelt, inspiring, and surprising stories of immigrants in America.

umc.cmc.6u8ovjqp61j46lx5cznidchhx.text: 查尔斯·彼得森和莉兹·彼得森找到了培养他们对狗狗的爱意的完美方式——字面意思。这对兄妹承担了照顾幼犬并为它们寻找永远的家的艰巨而又回报丰厚的任务。随着每一只新幼犬的到来，新的冒险开始了。
umc.cmc.6u8ovjqp61j46lx5cznidchhx.original: Charles and Lizzie Peterson have found the perfect way to foster their love of dogs—literally. The siblings take on the tough but rewarding task of fostering puppies and finding their forever homes. With every new pup, a new adventure begins.

umc.cmc.mzqa5sj4m2i80g51cgu04i3j.text: 当才华横溢的科学家安布尔·切斯伯勒在哥伦比亚和委内瑞拉边境失踪时，她的哥哥和丈夫——两人都是美国陆军精锐突击队员——在游击战中艰难地寻找她，却发现他们深爱的女人可能藏着一个秘密。
umc.cmc.mzqa5sj4m2i80g51cgu04i3j.original: When brilliant scientist Amber Chesborough vanishes along the Colombia-Venezuela border, her brother and her husband—both elite U.S. Army commandos—struggle to find her amid a guerilla war, discovering that the woman they love might have a secret.

umc.cmc.5yhan8dv6gc9ww55ua7z4dq5t.text: 在这部科幻选集剧集中，当不久未来的学生们经历神秘事件时，好奇心引发了混乱。
umc.cmc.5yhan8dv6gc9ww55ua7z4dq5t.original: In this sci-fi anthology series, curiosity leads to chaos when students in the near future experience mysterious events.

umc.cmc.5nghmxp88xe0qxhtlhfiu5r2h.text: 该剧根据贾斯汀·塞洛克斯的舅舅保罗·塞洛克斯创作的同名小说改编，讲述一名理想主义者（贾斯汀·塞洛克斯 饰）携全家定居在拉丁美洲的蚊子海岸，开辟了自己的乌托邦城市。而一场抢劫让一切毁于一旦。
umc.cmc.5nghmxp88xe0qxhtlhfiu5r2h.original: Allie Fox—a brilliant inventor and stubborn idealist—uproots his family for a dangerous quest through Mexico to flee the U.S. government and find safety.

umc.cmc.4r9fjly8gp831gqkfe8ft1xrb.text: 在这部吉姆·汉森公司出品、将 Slumberkins 的情感学习搬上银幕的剧集中，与大脚怪、独角兽、树懒、牦牛和狐狸一起踏上冒险之旅，探索情感的世界。
umc.cmc.4r9fjly8gp831gqkfe8ft1xrb.original: Embark on adventures with Bigfoot, Unicorn, Sloth, Yak, and Fox as they explore a world of feelings in this Jim Henson Company series that brings the emotional learning of Slumberkins to life.

umc.cmc.fj66nlndoybhmetv2a0dcarj.text: 藉由未曾面世的私人录音带和档案影片，引领观众从路易斯阿姆斯壮的视角，洞悉他的人生故事。讲述他如何从音乐巨星成为民权运动家，进而成为世界知名艺人。
umc.cmc.fj66nlndoybhmetv2a0dcarj.original: Never-before-heard personal recordings and archival footage tell the story of Louis Armstrong’s life from his perspective. From musical phenom to civil rights activist to world-renowned artist, this illuminating film shows sides of Armstrong few have seen.

umc.cmc.3z6okqcnxoo6ohte3k2z5vvrp.text: 90年代同名儿童剧的重启作，讲述一个在小型书店的鬼魂把书中的虚构人物释放到现实世界时，四个孩子因此组合起来为鬼魂解决各种未了之事。
umc.cmc.3z6okqcnxoo6ohte3k2z5vvrp.original: When a ghost haunts a neighborhood bookstore and starts releasing fictional characters into the real world, a group of friends team up to solve an exciting mystery surrounding the ghost’s unfinished business.

umc.cmc.atxsrive40xli3zh3uxjimut.text: 该剧改编自格里高利·大卫·罗伯茨2003年的同名畅销小说，讲述银行抢匪Lin Ford（查理·汉纳姆 饰）自澳洲越狱后逃往印度孟买，一场救赎之旅就此开启。 Shantaram在印地语代表“和平之人”。
umc.cmc.atxsrive40xli3zh3uxjimut.original: Escaped convict Lin Ford flees to the teeming streets of 1980s Bombay, looking to disappear. Working as a medic for the city’s poor and neglected, Lin finds unexpected love, connection, and courage on the long road to redemption.

umc.cmc.67f7csjyodc41iybksdv6s0pt.text: 杰克是克洛弗格罗夫最体贴、最关心他人的居民之一，总是以善良和幽默迎接每一个人。他传播同情心、创造力和想象力的能力，激励着镇上的每个人也这样做。
umc.cmc.67f7csjyodc41iybksdv6s0pt.original: Jack is one of Clover Grove’s most thoughtful and caring residents, greeting everyone with kindness and humor. His ability to spread compassion, creativity, and imagination inspires everyone in town to do the same.

umc.cmc.3tql7vmqfmedyw1ab7efys3z.text: 欢迎来到朗山奶牛场，这里是拖拉机奥蒂斯和他的所有朋友们的家园。奥蒂斯虽然个头小，但心地善良。每当他看到有朋友需要帮助，他就会踩下刹车查看情况，并迅速行动起来提供帮助。
umc.cmc.3tql7vmqfmedyw1ab7efys3z.original: Welcome to Long Hill Dairy Farm, home to Otis the tractor and all his friends. Otis may be little, but he has a big heart. Whenever he sees a friend in need, he hits the brakes to see what’s wrong and rolls into action to help.

umc.cmc.6f1xxgn2dg52deawakawg20r9.text: 威廉·沃尔夫并非普通的人类男孩。在精灵王国“万物工厂”的魔法世界里，他就是狼男孩。和新结识的精灵朋友们一起，他逐渐明白，自己丰富的想象力和无限的创造力拥有改变世界的力量。
umc.cmc.6f1xxgn2dg52deawakawg20r9.original: William Wolfe is no ordinary human boy. Down in the magical spryte realm of the Everything Factory, he’s Wolfboy. And with his new spryte friends, he learns his vivid imagination and limitless creativity have the power to change the world.

umc.cmc.3bz66deer36yb164foftii9pe.text: 这部由制片人奥普拉·温弗瑞打造的揭秘纪录片致敬了传奇人物西德尼·波蒂埃——这位标志性的演员、电影制作人和民权活动家。片中包含对丹泽尔·华盛顿、斯派克·李、芭芭拉·史翠珊等人的采访。
umc.cmc.3bz66deer36yb164foftii9pe.original: From producer Oprah Winfrey, this revealing documentary honors the legendary Sidney Poitier—iconic actor, filmmaker, and civil rights activist. Featuring interviews with Denzel Washington, Spike Lee, Barbra Streisand, and more.

umc.cmc.6pt51gvtzprx3h060b7944s3k.text: 与希拉里·克林顿和切尔西·克林顿一起踏上一段难忘的旅程，她们与世界上一些最大胆、最勇敢的女性展开冒险——从家喻户晓的名人到默默无闻的英雄——她们让我们开怀大笑，并激励我们变得更加勇敢。
umc.cmc.6pt51gvtzprx3h060b7944s3k.original: Take an unforgettable journey with Hillary Clinton and Chelsea Clinton as they go on adventures with some of the world’s boldest and bravest women—from household names to unsung heroes—who make us laugh and inspire us to be more gutsy.

umc.cmc.4qe3i11erof30x0vz8nwnjkw3.text: 苹果预订首部动画剧集《中央公园》(Central Park，暂译)。该剧两季，每季13集，洛伦·鲍查德(《开心汉堡店》)联手福斯TV打造，鲍查德、乔什·加德任编剧。故事围绕以中央公园为家并在那里工作的一家人展开。配音卡司包括克里斯汀·贝尔、乔什·加德、斯坦利·图齐、戴维德·迪格斯、小莱斯利·奥多姆、凯瑟琳·哈恩。
umc.cmc.4qe3i11erof30x0vz8nwnjkw3.original: In this animated musical comedy, Owen Tillerman and his family live an unconventional life in New York's bustling Central Park, which Owen manages. Now, they'll have to fend off a wealthy hotel heiress who wants to turn the park into condos.

umc.cmc.1suiyueh1ntwjtsstcwldofno.text: 在一次改变人生的经历后，13岁的艾拉渴望把握住每一天。当她学会珍惜每一刻的同时，她勇敢地面对以往内心的恐惧，并且鼓励他人也破除心里的畏惧。
umc.cmc.1suiyueh1ntwjtsstcwldofno.original: After a life-changing experience, 13-year-old Ella is eager to seize the day. As she learns to appreciate each moment, she faces the fears that once defined her—and encourages others to do the same.

umc.cmc.3s4mgg2y7h95fks9gnc4pw13m.text: 该剧由《浴血黑帮》编剧斯蒂文·奈特担任制作人，弗朗西斯·劳伦斯([红雀])执导，奈特与劳伦斯共同操刀剧本。剧集讲述在未来的世界，人类失去了视力，社会必须找到新的方式来交流互动、捕猎与生存。一对有视力的双胞胎诞生，所有这一切都受到挑战。莫玛将饰演一个无所畏惧的战士、领导者和守护人。
umc.cmc.3s4mgg2y7h95fks9gnc4pw13m.original: In the far future, humankind has lost its sense of sight. Jason Momoa stars as the father of twins born with the mythic ability to see—who must protect his tribe against a threatened queen. Dave Bautista and Alfre Woodard also star.

umc.cmc.4371g2xacdr0wfs071dm3q30x.text: 对于海滨密友萨姆和杰德来说，敏捷的机智让他们在宁静的家乡冲浪边侦破超自然谜团时有了大胆的发现。改编自畅销青少年图画小说。
umc.cmc.4371g2xacdr0wfs071dm3q30x.original: Quick wits lead to daring discoveries for beachside besties Sam and Jade as they sleuth out supernatural mysteries in their sleepy hometown of Surfside. Based on the best-selling young adult graphic novels.

umc.cmc.50agn5zbvuj7z70teq1p0pixn.text: 该剧改编自Sheri Fink的同名纪实文学，讲述新奥尔良一家医院里精疲力竭的护理人员在风暴过后被迫做出令人心碎的决定的故事。 在卡特里娜飓风席卷新奥尔良后，当时新奥尔纪念医疗中心遭受洪水泛滥、电力中断、气温急升等问题，而医务人员在这种恶劣环境下被迫作出困扰他们未来多年的选择。医院最终有40名死者，其中有些患者被认为无法活下去，故安排了安乐死。
umc.cmc.50agn5zbvuj7z70teq1p0pixn.original: Based on actual events from Hurricane Katrina. When the floodwaters rose, power failed, and heat soared, exhausted caregivers at a New Orleans hospital were forced to make profound, heart-wrenching decisions.

umc.cmc.2jx8ltni2dnxa5rxx7ip1mesm.text: 改编自残奥选手乔许李森德奎斯特 (Josh Sundquist) 真实故事，新锐童星罗根马米诺 (Logan Mamino) 出演，将其人生故事搬上荧幕的感人成长剧集
umc.cmc.2jx8ltni2dnxa5rxx7ip1mesm.original: Josh Dubin is thrilled to switch from homeschool to public school, and being the only kid with a prosthetic leg is a challenge he’s ready to face. As he carves out a place among his peers, his friends and family are with him every step of the way.

umc.cmc.30gx1y8nwthydkrvhqu156p3.text: 詹姆斯·基内（塔伦·埃哲顿 饰）出生在芝加哥，是一名警察的儿子。他曾是一名出色的橄榄球球手，并朝着职业道路发展。而他犯的错使他被判10年监禁，无假释机会。检察官给他一个将功补过的机会，但风险很高。有一个叫拉里·霍尔（保罗·沃尔特·豪泽 饰）的人绑架和谋杀了一个15岁女孩，而这个女孩仅仅是他过往杀害的19名女性之一，由于证据不足，霍尔或将被释放，基内的任务就是在狱中让霍尔承认他的谋杀行为。
umc.cmc.30gx1y8nwthydkrvhqu156p3.original: Inspired by actual events. As Jimmy Keene begins a 10-year prison sentence, he gets an incredible offer: If he can elicit a confession from suspected killer Larry Hall, Jimmy will be freed. Completing this mission becomes the challenge of a lifetime.

umc.cmc.qayvbuimq7lxab6y2cs9tbcj.text: 羽毛朋友小鸭和小鹅截然不同，但在一部学龄前儿童节目中，他们学会了如何激发彼此最好的一面。改编自塔德·希尔斯的书籍。
umc.cmc.qayvbuimq7lxab6y2cs9tbcj.original: Feathered friends Duck and Goose couldn’t be more different, but in this preschool show, they learn how to bring out the best in one another. Based on books by Tad Hills.

umc.cmc.5xjrgoblr5l5i1ypamtayuhe9.text: 苹果正式预定了首部纪录片剧集《家园》，共10集，Matthew Weaver（《冒牌家庭》《心碎度蜜月》）、Matt Tynauer（《华伦天奴：末代帝王》）、Corey Reese联合制作，带观众走进世界上最非凡的家庭建筑，揭开那些敢于想象和探索的建筑者们的幕后故事。
umc.cmc.5xjrgoblr5l5i1ypamtayuhe9.original: Discover the groundbreaking ideas and inspiring stories behind the world’s most imaginative dwellings. In this globe-spanning docuseries, meet the visionaries who are challenging conventional concepts of “home” and rethinking how we live.

umc.cmc.4xpk6thd1574yu8hy2xdozyz6.text: 标志性运动员们揭开了他们触及伟大的关键职业生涯时刻的面纱。这部真人与视觉效果相结合的风格化短片纪录剧集，为那些你以为自己很了解的体育传奇人物带来了新的视角。
umc.cmc.4xpk6thd1574yu8hy2xdozyz6.original: Iconic athletes pull back the curtain on a pivotal career moment when they touched greatness. A stylized hybrid of live action and visual effects, this short-form docuseries sheds new light on the sports legends you thought you knew.

umc.cmc.1vyhx06lta7a21tshl8qitota.text: 本剧改编自Sarah Perry的同名小说，讲述刚丧偶的Cora Seaborne（Claire Danes 饰），从伦敦搬去了埃塞克斯郡，调查关于一条神秘之蛇的传闻。Cora与村里的牧师Will Ransome（Tom Hiddleston 饰）建立起了意料之外的纽带，但当悲剧来临时，当地人指控她吸引了这种神秘生物。
umc.cmc.1vyhx06lta7a21tshl8qitota.original: London widow Cora Seaborne moves to Essex to investigate reports of a mythical serpent. She forms a surprising bond of science and skepticism with the local vicar—but when tragedy strikes, locals accuse her of attracting the creature.

umc.cmc.3flhku7zffp93eqd53bqlzi04.text: 母亲节就要到了，大伙都很兴奋——除了薄荷帕蒂。对她来说，这提醒着她成长过程中没有妈妈陪伴。但好朋友玛茜帮助薄荷帕蒂认识到，家庭有各种各样的形状和大小。
umc.cmc.3flhku7zffp93eqd53bqlzi04.original: Mother’s Day is almost here, and the gang is excited—except Peppermint Patty. For her, it’s a reminder that she didn’t grow up with a mom. But good pal Marcie helps Peppermint Patty see that families come in all shapes and sizes.

umc.cmc.5nidhx69sm3a7gtv2a4k0l0lw.text: 深入事件背后，看他如何骗倒美国政府，犯下美国史上最大宗的福利金诈骗案。
umc.cmc.5nidhx69sm3a7gtv2a4k0l0lw.original: Eric C. Conn was a lawyer living a little too large in eastern Kentucky…until two whistleblowers realized he was at the center of government fraud worth over half a billion dollars, one of the largest in U.S. history. And that was just the beginning.

umc.cmc.22xs4xobsimzy5qqdif0rhmdy.text: 本剧改编自Lauren Beukes的畅销小说《The Shinning Girls》。故事讲述Kirby Mazrachi（Elisabeth Moss饰），一位芝加哥记者，她从一次残忍的袭击中幸存了下来，但在追寻这个袭击者时，她发现自己的现实发生了巨大的变化。在了解到近期一起凶案跟自己情况相似后，Kirby和麻烦不断的资深记者Dan Velazquez（Wagner Moura饰）组成搭档，一起查明袭击者的身份。两人逐渐发现这些悬案有所关联，但他们的私人创伤和Kirby自己模糊不清的现实，导致袭击者总是抢先一步。
umc.cmc.22xs4xobsimzy5qqdif0rhmdy.original: Years after a brutal attack left her in a constantly shifting reality, Kirby Mazrachi learns that a recent murder is linked to her assault. She teams with veteran reporter Dan Velazquez to understand her ever-changing present—and confront her past.

umc.cmc.67518fzfnhcjcajidzbpff8i5.text: 埃尔文·“魔术师”·约翰逊是一位跨越时代的偶像——从卑微的起点到梦之队，再到商业巨头。这部纪录剧集包含对奥巴马总统、拉里·伯德、帕特·莱利等人的采访，记录了一位传奇人物的生活和职业生涯。
umc.cmc.67518fzfnhcjcajidzbpff8i5.original: Earvin “Magic” Johnson is an icon for the ages—from humble beginnings to the Dream Team to business titan. Featuring interviews with President Obama, Larry Bird, Pat Riley, and more, this docuseries charts the life and career of a legend.

umc.cmc.6yrn30c9ab16ndqxwlld0tdi0.text: 五星高中生马库尔梅克是即将加人NBA选秀的潜力新秀，直到一场意外转折让他进入霍华大学。这出励志的纪录片影集记录马库尔的心路历程与决心，要在家人的协助下改写自己的故事。
umc.cmc.6yrn30c9ab16ndqxwlld0tdi0.original: Makur Maker was a five-star NBA prospect headed to the Draft—until an unexpected detour led him to Howard University. This inspiring docuseries follows Makur’s journey and his determination to rewrite his story with the help of his family.

umc.cmc.2os8kmimhw58fqxcu7xcmx8hd.text: 本剧基于Cecelia Ahern所著短篇小说，每个故事都从一个独特的女性视角讲述，探索自己生活中与众不同、荒谬的矛盾和问题，涵盖了各种各样的流派，共8集，每集半小时。
umc.cmc.2os8kmimhw58fqxcu7xcmx8hd.original: Featuring an all-star cast, this genre-bending anthology series weaves together eight darkly comedic feminist fables that take unexpected approaches to subjects like gender roles, autonomy, and identity.

umc.cmc.3oxevpgaoqomu820s0e70ri75.text: 道格是一个年轻的机器人，他感觉生活不仅仅只有冰冷的事实。当其他机器人在插电进行每日下载时，道格拔掉电源，与他的好朋友艾玛一起走进人类世界，去亲身体验其中的奇妙。
umc.cmc.3oxevpgaoqomu820s0e70ri75.original: Doug is a young robot who senses there’s more to life than just the facts. While other robots plug in for their daily download, Doug unplugs and journeys into the human world with his best friend Emma to experience its wonders firsthand.

umc.cmc.6qw605uv2rwbzutk2p2fsgvq9.text: 本剧改编自6集播客《WeCrashed: The Rise and Fall of WeWork》，由Lee Eisenberg和Drew Crevello编剧，讲述共享办公室公司WeWork的崛起以及衰落。在不到十年内，WeWork从一个共享办公空间发展成为一个470亿美元的全球品牌。然后又在短短的一年之内，损失了400亿美元。到底发生了什么事？
umc.cmc.6qw605uv2rwbzutk2p2fsgvq9.original: Inspired by actual events—and the love story at the center of it all. WeWork grew from a single coworking space into a global brand worth $47 billion in under a decade. Then, in less than a year, its valuation dropped $40 billion. What happened?

umc.cmc.bj6odozsws1abio4bkiy69g5.text: 一个91岁的男子，被家人和朋友甚至他自己所遗忘，即将深深陷入孤独和痴呆。而在有机会短暂重获记忆时，格雷身上发生了巨大的转变，他要利用自己宝贵的清明时间去揭开侄子的死的谜题，以及接受自己的过去。
umc.cmc.bj6odozsws1abio4bkiy69g5.original: Suddenly left without his trusted caretaker, Ptolemy Grey is assigned to the care of orphaned teenager Robyn. When they learn about a treatment that will restore Ptolemy’s dementia-addled memories, it begins a journey toward shocking truths.

umc.cmc.3bcp1uw2craeu8lbc53h7i205.text: 该剧集利用粉丝写给名人的信件，回顾这些极具影响力的人的生活。 出镜的名人包括奥普拉·温弗瑞、格洛丽亚·斯泰纳姆、珍·古道尔、斯派克·李、林-曼努尔·米兰达、斯蒂夫·旺达、亚历山德拉·莱斯曼、雅拉·沙希迪等。
umc.cmc.3bcp1uw2craeu8lbc53h7i205.original: One person’s story can change the world. From Emmy®-winning filmmaker R.J. Cutler, this docuseries profiles game-changing icons and the people whose lives they’ve inspired.

umc.cmc.7003fizrrxznfhz1s20vv7ewy.text: 探索你从未见过的亚伯拉罕·林肯的一面。在这部四集纪录片中，多元的历史学家小组和罕见的档案资料对这位被称为伟大解放者的人物提供了更细致入微的审视。
umc.cmc.7003fizrrxznfhz1s20vv7ewy.original: Discover a side of Abraham Lincoln you’ve never seen before. In this four-part docuseries, a diverse panel of historians and rare archival materials offer a more nuanced look into the man dubbed the Great Emancipator.

umc.cmc.64yj71dmrdihhmo96h0lgjmw5.text: 乌玛·瑟曼将主演苹果新剧《怀疑》(Suspicion，暂译)。该剧卡司还包括昆瑙·内亚(《生活大爆炸》)、诺亚·艾默里奇(《美国谍梦》)、乔治娜·坎贝尔(《黑镜》)、伊莱耶斯·加贝尔(《天蝎》)、伊丽莎白·亨斯屈奇(《神盾局特工》)、安琪儿·库碧(《梅林传奇》)。剧集改编自以色列剧集《False Flag》，讲述21岁的利奥在纽约的一家大型高端旅馆被绑架，而且被拍成了视频，视频在网上引起了轰动。4名居住在这家酒店的英国人成为了主要被怀疑的对象。乌玛将饰演利奥的母亲，她是一位成功的商人。罗伯·威廉姆斯担任剧集运作人，克里斯·朗(《美国谍梦》)执导。
umc.cmc.64yj71dmrdihhmo96h0lgjmw5.original: Four ordinary Brits are accused of kidnapping the son of a prominent U.S. media mogul. They embark on a desperate race against time to prove their innocence, but will anyone believe them—and are they telling the truth?

umc.cmc.4wpfk1xmi22h3zyv4a10lj1tw.text: 影片以华盛顿饰演的麦克白为主线，他被三个女巫说服，认为自己注定要成为苏格兰国王。他和野心勃勃的妻子麦克白夫人(麦克多蒙德饰)一起，开始把预言变成现实……结果是大量的鲜血、背叛和死亡。格里森饰演国王邓肯，米尔林饰演邓肯的儿子马尔科姆，霍金斯饰演麦克达夫。布鲁诺·德尔邦内尔([醉乡民谣])担任摄影师。
umc.cmc.4wpfk1xmi22h3zyv4a10lj1tw.original: Nominated for 3 Oscars®, including Best Actor. Denzel Washington and Frances McDormand star in Joel Coen’s bold and fierce adaptation—a tale of murder, madness, ambition, and wrathful cunning.

umc.cmc.775eomzc9ljfk7bop9shbu7m0.text: 短片讲述了在一座兔子小镇上小兔子Cece在小时候患上了一种严重疾病导致她失去了听力。失去听力之后的Cece不得不戴上助听器以及学习读唇语才能够正常的与人交流和进行日常生活。
umc.cmc.775eomzc9ljfk7bop9shbu7m0.original: Going to school and making new friends can be tough. Having to do both while wearing a bulky hearing aid on your chest? That takes superpowers! With a little help from her superhero alter ego, El Deafo, Cece learns to embrace her differences.

umc.cmc.2u5ulzjcxh7e50uhichjjlsv6.text: 影片以不久的将来为背景，通过卡梅伦（马赫沙拉·阿里 Mahershala Ali 饰）的眼睛讲述了一段充满力量和情感的旅程。卡梅伦被诊断患有绝症，医生向他提出了另一种解决方案，以保护他的家人免受悲痛。当卡梅伦挣扎着是否要改变他的家庭命运时，他学到了比他想象的更多关于生活和爱情的知识。影片探索了我们将走多远，以及我们愿意牺 牲多少，为我们所爱的人创造更幸福的生活。
umc.cmc.2u5ulzjcxh7e50uhichjjlsv6.original: In the near future, Cameron Turner is diagnosed with a terminal illness. Presented with an experimental solution to shield his wife and son from grief, he grapples with altering their fate in this thought-provoking exploration of love, loss, and sacrifice.

umc.cmc.5xuo4simneuqt8ibn2kyskonu.text: 在得知祖母不会来过圣诞节后，露西决定举办一场终极跨年派对来振作精神。与此同时，查理·布朗试图在午夜钟声敲响之前实现他的一项新年愿望。
umc.cmc.5xuo4simneuqt8ibn2kyskonu.original: After finding out her grandmother won’t be visiting for Christmas, Lucy decides to cheer herself up by throwing the ultimate New Year’s Eve party. Meanwhile, Charlie Brown tries to fulfill one of his resolutions before the clock strikes midnight.

umc.cmc.227bl4rudf84e4pwouml1lss0.text: 圣诞女王携满满的节日欢乐回归这部特辑。玛丽亚与哈利德和柯克·富兰克林一同表演了她迷人的原创歌曲《Fall in Love at Christmas》，与 Apple Music 的赞恩·洛进行了交谈，并以一首节日经典曲目结束。
umc.cmc.227bl4rudf84e4pwouml1lss0.original: The Queen of Christmas returns with a blast of holiday cheer in this special. Mariah performs her enchanting original song “Fall in Love at Christmas” with Khalid and Kirk Franklin, chats with Apple Music’s Zane Lowe, and signs off with a festive classic.

umc.cmc.4u53f7zokr7g40tjj4gs61xbu.text: 在隐蔽的现代战争中，正确与错误的界限已经模糊。这部纪录片审视了战争的道德模糊性，具体体现在2018年的一个案件中，当时美国海军海豹突击队的一个排指控其长官埃迪·加拉格尔犯有战争罪。
umc.cmc.4u53f7zokr7g40tjj4gs61xbu.original: In covert modern warfare, the line between right and wrong has blurred. This docuseries examines the moral ambiguities of war as embodied by the 2018 case in which a U.S. Navy SEAL platoon accused its chief, Eddie Gallagher, of war crimes.

umc.cmc.jov1gljmqnux0i15rbqsoyfk.text: 灵感来自马蒂和彻底改变了他的人生随后又将其接管的治疗师的真实故事。当马蒂第一次见到艾克医生时，他只是想更好地划清界限。在30年的时间里，他将全面了解界限——以及当界限被越过时会发生什么。
umc.cmc.jov1gljmqnux0i15rbqsoyfk.original: Inspired by the true story of Marty and the therapist who turned his life around...then took it over. When he first meets Dr. Ike, Marty just wants to get better at boundaries. Over 30 years, he'll learn all about them—and what happens when they get crossed.

umc.cmc.47dkj9f2ho3h8dwxixflz65q5.text: 在世界末日后的地球上，一个为保护造物主的爱犬而生的机器人，学习生活、爱情、友谊以及作为人类意味着什么。
umc.cmc.47dkj9f2ho3h8dwxixflz65q5.original: Tom Hanks is Finch, a man who embarks on a moving and powerful journey to find a new home for his unlikely family—his beloved dog and a newly created robot—in a dangerous and ravaged world.

umc.cmc.1ogyy5s2agasxa5qztabrlykn.text: 第三季着眼于艾米莉·狄金森作为一名艺术家最富有成效的时期，发生在正在进行的美国内战和一场分裂她自己家庭的激烈战斗之间。
umc.cmc.1ogyy5s2agasxa5qztabrlykn.original: Hailee Steinfeld stars as Emily Dickinson. Poet. Daughter. Total rebel. In this coming-of-age story, Emily’s determined to become the world’s greatest poet.

umc.cmc.60vbrno9xpmmax8wmdo4ow05u.text: 李善均将主演Apple TV+首个韩语原创剧集《头脑博士》(Dr. Brain，暂译)。该剧将由金知云([密探])自编自导，故事改编自同名人气网络漫画，讲述一位大脑科学家的故事，他沉迷于开发一种新的技术以探访大脑的意识和记忆。当他的家庭成为一场神秘事故的受害者，他的生活陷入困境。他利用自己的技术从妻子的大脑中获取记忆，拼凑出他的家庭究竟经历了什么，以及这些事情发生的原因。该剧由YG旗下影视公司Studioplex和Bound Entertainment制作，目前已经开拍，计划于今年晚些时候开播。
umc.cmc.60vbrno9xpmmax8wmdo4ow05u.original: From visionary filmmaker Kim Jee-woon. Brilliant brain scientist Sewon (Lee Sun-kyun) suffers a horrific personal tragedy. Desperate to uncover what happened to his family, he conducts “brain syncs” with the dead to access their memories for clues.

umc.cmc.2iams7vr2o0i6mtb6wm6r9q1n.text: 失意的音乐家乔什·科曼在圣费尔南多谷公立学校教五年级，他的未婚妻梅根离他而去，高中朋友维克多搬来同住，科曼在焦虑、孤独和自我怀疑中成长。
umc.cmc.2iams7vr2o0i6mtb6wm6r9q1n.original: With better luck, better choices, better posture...Josh Corman could’ve been a rock star. Now he teaches fifth grade, and though he loves his students, he still struggles to find happiness and meaning in a world that sometimes feels short on both.

umc.cmc.56ka6i8ccv7tsatj6nd1uo808.text: 荣获奥斯卡奖®和格莱美奖®的制作人兼艺术家马克·容森与他的偶像及同行热曲制造者——包括保罗·麦卡特尼、DJ普雷米尔、查莉·XCX、戴夫·格罗尔和奎斯特拉夫——共同探讨了技术与音乐创新的交汇点。
umc.cmc.56ka6i8ccv7tsatj6nd1uo808.original: Oscar®- and GRAMMY Award®–winning producer and artist Mark Ronson explores the intersection of technology and musical innovation with his heroes and fellow hitmakers—including Paul McCartney, DJ Premier, Charli XCX, Dave Grohl, and Questlove.

umc.cmc.5yqy2wv4w7l0v4x5mn3le8l1y.text: 一名小女孩和家人搬回父亲曾居住过的小镇，而她对真相的执着，让一桩陈年悬案重新浮出水面。 本剧取材自九岁小记者希尔迪·凯特·利沙克（Hilde Kate Lysiak）2016年写下的真实报导。
umc.cmc.5yqy2wv4w7l0v4x5mn3le8l1y.original: A mystery inspired by the reporting of a young investigative journalist. When Hilde and her family move back to the small town her father left behind, her pursuit of the truth leads to the unearthing of shocking secrets.

umc.cmc.34uwnqvp7211b9fl3vb25vled.text: 这部令人毛骨悚然的惊悚片改编自斯蒂芬·金的小说，讲述了寡妇莉西·兰登（朱丽安·摩尔饰）的故事，一系列令人不安的事件唤醒了她对与作家丈夫斯科特·兰登（克里夫·欧文饰）的婚姻以及困扰他的黑暗的回忆。
umc.cmc.34uwnqvp7211b9fl3vb25vled.original: Based on the novel by Stephen King, this terrifying thriller follows widow Lisey Landon (Julianne Moore) as a series of disturbing events revives memories of her marriage to author Scott Landon (Clive Owen) and the darkness that plagued him.

umc.cmc.4amwght1qtt8ioilwr0mgnf6d.text: 奥普拉·温弗瑞、哈里王子联合监制的Apple TV+纪录剧集《你看不见的我》(The Me You Can’t See，暂译)将于5月21日开播。该剧嘉宾包括Lady Gaga、格伦·克洛斯、德玛尔·德罗赞等，奥普拉、哈里王子将与嘉宾们就心理健康问题展开讨论，嘉宾们也将分享自己的故事。
umc.cmc.4amwght1qtt8ioilwr0mgnf6d.original: Oprah Winfrey and Prince Harry join forces to guide honest discussions about mental health. This series features illuminating stories from across the globe, giving us the opportunity to seek truth, understanding, and a newfound hope for the future.

umc.cmc.6dkxf7hxdcaueu4jhe1wm2k2n.text: 在一个动荡的时代，1971年是受当时政治和文化剧变推动而充满音乐创新与重生的年份。巨星们达到了新的高度，崭新的才华惊艳登场，边界以前所未有的方式拓展。
umc.cmc.6dkxf7hxdcaueu4jhe1wm2k2n.original: In a tumultuous era, 1971 was a year of musical innovation and rebirth fueled by the political and cultural upheaval of the time. Stars reached new heights, fresh talent exploded onto the scene, and boundaries expanded like never before.

umc.cmc.37dvcdop7ub4m8tx9fnczl1a1.text: 这部纪录片由汤姆·希德勒斯顿担任旁白，在六大洲拍摄，运用了尖端的摄像技术来捕捉动物的夜间生活，以前所未有的全彩画面揭示了全新的行为。
umc.cmc.37dvcdop7ub4m8tx9fnczl1a1.original: Narrated by Tom Hiddleston and filmed across six continents, this docuseries uses cutting-edge camera technology to capture animals' nocturnal lives, revealing new behaviors filmed in full color like never before.

umc.cmc.1sid6bqjoez4sxonuulq12af7.text: 该纪录影集由保罗·路德[ 蚁人 ]担任解说，以令人叹为观止的摄影技术，带领观众深入大自然，探索各种小型生物坚韧的生命力，见证这些鲜为人知的小英雄背后的故事。
umc.cmc.1sid6bqjoez4sxonuulq12af7.original: Narrated by Paul Rudd, this docuseries showcases nature's lesser-known tiny heroes. Spotlighting small creatures and the extraordinary things they do to survive, each episode is filled with surprising stories and spectacular cinematography.

umc.cmc.3fob3t7nfhehpb3ilgynzxmnu.text: 为庆祝 2021 年世界地球日 ，Apple TV+ 将首播原创纪录片特辑《这一年，地球变得不一样》，由获得艾美奖及 BAFTA 奖项的 David Attenborough 担任旁白。 《这一年，地球变得不一样》展示世界各地历经史无前例的一年之后所拍摄的独家影片，这部贴近时事的纪录片，不但以全新手法描绘全球大封锁的局面，也带大家看见许多由此而生的正向故事。沉寂的城市传来鸟鸣、鲸鱼有了新沟通方式、水豚出没于南美洲郊区，世界各地的人都有机会以前所未见的方式接触大自然。在一小时的特辑中，观众将看见人类的行为改变可为大自然带来实实在在的影响。诸如减少邮轮交通、每年关闭沙滩数日、找出人类和野生动物和谐共处的方法等，都是影响因素。这部由 David Attenborough 讲述旁白的纪录片，是一封献给地球的暖心情书，著重呈现大自然的复甦能为未来带来光明希望。...
umc.cmc.3fob3t7nfhehpb3ilgynzxmnu.original: Narrated by David Attenborough, never-before-seen footage shows how our living in lockdown opened the door for nature to bounce back and thrive. Across the seas, skies, and lands, Earth found its rhythm when we came to a stop.

umc.cmc.7hp8sparfsxo0l4f712f3mf2r.text: 本剧根据法国同名剧集改编，每集将以一连串的电话通话内容交织而成。创新的呈现方式，让观众抽丝剥茧，探索一桩毁灭性的事件，如何让一群陌生人陷入神秘而又令人惊慌失措的情境之中。
umc.cmc.7hp8sparfsxo0l4f712f3mf2r.original: Told through a series of interconnected phone conversations, this groundbreaking series chronicles the mysterious story of a group of strangers whose lives are thrown into disarray in the lead-up to an apocalyptic event.

umc.cmc.40qrv09i2yfh8iilyi4s8vfi.text: 在坐牢12年后，前高中橄榄球明星埃迪·帕尔默回到了家乡，开始全新的生活。他和来自一个麻烦家庭的弃儿山姆建立了一种意想不到的联系，但埃迪的过去威胁到他的新生活和家庭。
umc.cmc.40qrv09i2yfh8iilyi4s8vfi.original: After 12 years in prison, former high school football star Eddie Palmer returns home to put his life back together—and forms an unlikely bond with Sam, an outcast boy from a troubled home. But Eddie's past threatens to ruin his new life and family.

umc.cmc.1h3msl5cfif0fz9my2kgvtk36.text: 通过闪回和闪前，讲述了青春不再的电影导演Alice (Ayelet Zurer)，对年轻编剧Sophie (Lihi Kornowski)日益痴迷。后者黑暗而令人不安的剧本，似乎并不只是虚构故事那么简单。
umc.cmc.1h3msl5cfif0fz9my2kgvtk36.original: In this internationally acclaimed psychological thriller, Alice is a middle-aged film director who feels lost since raising her family. But a chance meeting with Sophie, a femme-fatale screenwriter, takes Alice on an obsessive journey toward success at any cost.

umc.cmc.4dmcdxw4vbu5smkk8f44a1l3h.text: 苹果将制作《玛丽亚·凯莉的奇幻圣诞节特别节目》(Mariah Carey’s Magical Christmas Special，暂译)。玛丽亚·凯莉与伊恩·斯图尔特、Raj Kapoor、Ashley Edens担任执行制作人，哈密什·汉密尔顿、罗曼·科波拉执导。该特别节目将由一个温暖的故事串联起音乐、舞蹈与动画，并将于今年冬季登陆Apple TV+。
umc.cmc.4dmcdxw4vbu5smkk8f44a1l3h.original: Faced with a holiday cheer crisis, the North Pole knows there's only one person who can save the day: Santa's great friend Mariah Carey. The Queen of Christmas creates a fabulous and star-studded spectacular to make the whole world merry!

umc.cmc.4kxqi7mmx247xjrdfll0lsme1.text: 沃纳·赫尔佐格将再度联手地球学家克里夫·奥芬海默拍摄纪录片[火球](Fireball，暂译)，聚焦陨星和彗星。奥芬海默曾现身2016年赫尔佐格自编自导的Netflix纪录片[进入地狱]，此次二人将共执导筒。英国制片公司Spring Films与赫尔佐格的制片公司Werner Herzog Filmproduktion联合制作。
umc.cmc.4kxqi7mmx247xjrdfll0lsme1.original: From directors Werner Herzog and Clive Oppenheimer, this remarkable journey across our planet and universe explores how meteorites, shooting stars, and deep impacts have awoken our wonder about other realms—and make us rethink our destinies.

umc.cmc.2eln6544k8wo99s3vrdl5amwf.text: 记录小朋友成长初期的故事
umc.cmc.2eln6544k8wo99s3vrdl5amwf.original: Narrated by Olivia Colman and told through the eyes of over 100 kids across the globe, this docuseries chronicles how children learn to think, speak, move, and love from birth to age five.

umc.cmc.1mydlea6wicrm013138speg6m.text: 索菲亚·科波拉将执导新片《触礁》(On the Rocks)，比尔·莫瑞、拉什达·琼斯主演，这将是苹果和A24合作的第一部电影，下月开拍。 剧本由科波拉编写，讲述一个年轻妈妈和她有英雄色彩的父亲重新联系，在纽约展开一段冒险。
umc.cmc.1mydlea6wicrm013138speg6m.original: Faced with sudden doubts about her marriage, a young New York mother (Rashida Jones) teams up with her larger-than-life playboy father (Bill Murray) to tail her husband (Marlon Wayans) in a bittersweet comedy written and directed by Sofia Coppola.

umc.cmc.1hij2tkngu40vo4bq3rejym8v.text: Apple TV+ 独家推出这位美国摇滚教父新碟制作过程全纪录，纪录片将带领观众一睹这位教父的音乐创作过程，由 Bruce 本人亲自剖白制作全新专辑《Letter To You》的所思所感，并收录 Bruce 与传奇乐队班底 The E Street Band 的原整歌曲演出、幕后花絮片段及从未曝光的昔日珍贵片段新作不但向 Bruce 身后的 E Street Band 一众出色乐手致敬，亦是 Bruce 本人向摇滚音乐致敬的深情自白书。
umc.cmc.1hij2tkngu40vo4bq3rejym8v.original: A tribute to The E Street Band, rock ‘n’ roll, and the way music has shaped Bruce Springsteen’s life, this documentary captures Bruce reflecting on love and loss while recording with his full band live in the studio for the first time since Born in the U.S.A.

umc.cmc.1nv0tluok21c2f8549mdjqdnh.text: 史诗般的摩托车冒险在 Long Way 系列的第三篇章中延续，伊万·麦格雷戈和查理·布鲁曼骑着原型电动哈雷戴维森摩托车，穿梭于南美洲和中美洲壮丽的风景中。
umc.cmc.1nv0tluok21c2f8549mdjqdnh.original: The epic motorcycle adventure continues in this third chapter of the Long Way series, as Ewan McGregor and Charley Boorman journey to glorious landscapes across South and Central America—on the backs of prototype electric Harley-Davidsons.

umc.cmc.1aatz9gwjhnpfqqt8noafagq.text: 故事讲述来自得克萨斯州的1000个17岁男孩参加了从零开始的代议制政府的故事。
umc.cmc.1aatz9gwjhnpfqqt8noafagq.original: This raucous journey into the heart of democracy captures an unusual rite of passage: 1,100 teenage boys from across Texas coming together to build a representative government from the ground up. Winner of the Sundance Grand Jury Prize.

umc.cmc.49yt85r7ow6904u0177r694qy.text: 奥普拉与当今最杰出的新闻人物、思想领袖以及各领域的顶尖大师进行深入探讨。他们为塑造我们世界的各种议题带来真相与视角，揭示引人入胜的人际连接故事。
